title: 'HLB Islamic salur RM138,600 pembiayaan kepada melalui SURI Inspirasi
body: 'PETALING JAYA: HLB Islamic menyalurkan pembiayaan sebanyak RM138,600 kepada perusahaan sosial SURI Inspirasi (SURI) di bawah kerangka iTEKAD Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM), selaras dengan komitmen untuk memperkasakan ekosistem perantaraan berasaskan Pengantaraan Berasaskan Nilai (VBI). Inisiatif itu secara langsung menyumbang kepada peningkatan purata pendapatan bulanan sebanyak 94 peratus serta menjana jumlah pendapatan baharu melebihi RM14,000 bagi usahawan yang menyertai program Sustainable Reliable Income (SRI) anjuran SURI. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif HLB Islamic, Dafinah Ahmed Hilmi berkata, visi bank dalam pengurusan kewangan berteraskan Hayat @ HLB Islamic iaitu pengurusan harta dilihat sebagai satu perjalanan yang bermula dengan penciptaan harta. “Melalui kerjasama dengan SURI, kami menyediakan alat dan latihan asas yang diperlukan oleh komuniti untuk mencungkil potensi keusahawanan mereka. “Kami berharap usaha ini akan menjadi pemangkin kepada perjalanan pembinaan kekayaan berterusan ke arah kebebasan kewangan yang bakal memperkayakan komuniti untuk generasi akan datang,” katanya dalam kenyataan. HLB Islamic berkata, program SRI memperkasakan komuniti berpendapatan rendah untuk mengitar semula sisa fabrik menjadi barangan fesyen yang unik, yang secara langsung mewujudkan peluang pekerjaan dan memupuk semangat keusahawanan, di samping mempromosikan fesyen sifar sisa serta pemerkasaan komuniti. “Usahawan yang terlibat, yang majoriti ibu tunggal berpendapatan rendah telah menghasilkan 1,000 pasang pakaian seragam sekolah untuk pelajar bagi lima buah sekolah di Langkawi, sekali gus menjana penjimatan sebanyak RM30,000 bagi keluarga tempatan. “HLB Islamic meraikan pencapaian ini menerusi penyerahan mesin jahit berkualiti tinggi kepada para usahawan yang terlibat, menandakan peralihan daripada pembelajaran di dalam bilik darjah kepada pemilikan perniagaan secara aktif,” ujarnya. Tambahnya, kejayaan ini menandakan satu pencapaian penting dalam kerjasama berterusan antara HLB Islamic dan SURI, yang mula menyertai ekosistem bank ini sebagai peserta inisiatif HLB Jumpstart. “Diperkenalkan bagi memupuk perusahaan sosial Malaysia yang berimpak tinggi menerusi bimbingan komersial, penjenamaan, serta pembinaan kapasiti digital, HLB Jumpstart telah menyediakan kerangka awal kepada SURI untuk memperluas operasinya. “Hal ini membuktikan strategi jangka panjang bank dalam memupuk usaha sosial menjadi rakan pelaksana berdikari yang mampu memberikan impak yang lebih meluas,” jelasnya. – UTUSAN

Inisiatif itu secara langsung menyumbang kepada peningkatan purata pendapatan bulanan sebanyak 94 peratus serta menjana jumlah pendapatan baharu melebihi RM14,000 bagi usahawan yang menyertai program Sustainable Reliable Income (SRI) anjuran SURI. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif HLB Islamic, Dafinah Ahmed Hilmi berkata, visi bank dalam pengurusan kewangan berteraskan Hayat @ HLB Islamic iaitu pengurusan harta dilihat sebagai satu perjalanan yang bermula dengan penciptaan harta. “Melalui kerjasama dengan SURI, kami menyediakan alat dan latihan asas yang diperlukan oleh komuniti untuk mencungkil potensi keusahawanan mereka. “Kami berharap usaha ini akan menjadi pemangkin kepada perjalanan pembinaan kekayaan berterusan ke arah kebebasan kewangan yang bakal memperkayakan komuniti untuk generasi akan datang,” katanya dalam kenyataan. HLB Islamic berkata, program SRI memperkasakan komuniti berpendapatan rendah untuk mengitar semula sisa fabrik menjadi barangan fesyen yang unik, yang secara langsung mewujudkan peluang pekerjaan dan memupuk semangat keusahawanan, di samping mempromosikan fesyen sifar sisa serta pemerkasaan komuniti. “Usahawan yang terlibat, yang majoriti ibu tunggal berpendapatan rendah telah menghasilkan 1,000 pasang pakaian seragam sekolah untuk pelajar bagi lima buah sekolah di Langkawi, sekali gus menjana penjimatan sebanyak RM30,000 bagi keluarga tempatan. “HLB Islamic meraikan pencapaian ini menerusi penyerahan mesin jahit berkualiti tinggi kepada para usahawan yang terlibat, menandakan peralihan daripada pembelajaran di dalam bilik darjah kepada pemilikan perniagaan secara aktif,” ujarnya. Tambahnya, kejayaan ini menandakan satu pencapaian penting dalam kerjasama berterusan antara HLB Islamic dan SURI, yang mula menyertai ekosistem bank ini sebagai peserta inisiatif HLB Jumpstart. “Diperkenalkan bagi memupuk perusahaan sosial Malaysia yang berimpak tinggi menerusi bimbingan komersial, penjenamaan, serta pembinaan kapasiti digital, HLB Jumpstart telah menyediakan kerangka awal kepada SURI untuk memperluas operasinya. “Hal ini membuktikan strategi jangka panjang bank dalam memupuk usaha sosial menjadi rakan pelaksana berdikari yang mampu memberikan impak yang lebih meluas,” jelasnya. – UTUSAN

title: 'HLB Targets Wealthy Clients With New opus Privilege Ecosystem
body:
'

Hong Leong Bank is strengthening its affluent banking strategy with HLB opus, an invitation-only payment and lifestyle programme built for selected high-value clients.

The launch combines premium banking, travel benefits and wealth relationships into a single proposition.


At the centre is Southeast Asia’s first ceramic credit card.

HLB opus is also the first payment experience in Malaysia to use the Visa Infinite Privilege tier.

However, the bigger story is not the card material.

HLB is using opus to connect business banking, private wealth management and premium lifestyle benefits under one customer relationship.

HLB Connects Business Success With Personal Wealth

HLB calls the strategy its “One Bank” client success model.

The approach reflects how many high-net-worth customers interact with banks.

Their financial relationships can span business financing, corporate accounts, investments, private banking and personal spending.

HLB wants opus to sit at the personal end of that journey.

Business & Corporate Banking supports entrepreneurship and company growth.

Private Banking helps clients structure and preserve wealth.

Personal Financial Services then translates that relationship into travel, lifestyle and rewards benefits.

The model allows HLB to position opus as a product earned through a broader financial relationship rather than a conventional premium credit card application.

Ceramic Card Reinforces Exclusivity

The physical HLB opus card uses Convego Ceramic technology from Giesecke+Devrient.

Ceramic remains uncommon in the payment card industry, where most premium offerings rely on metal.

The HLB card is manufactured using extreme heat and pressure before undergoing diamond finishing.

The result is designed to be scratch resistant while offering a smooth texture and reflective appearance.

HLB sees the material as part of the product’s wider symbolism.

The name “opus” comes from the Latin word associated with work or achievement.

That concept is intended to connect the physical card with the professional and financial achievements of the clients invited to hold it.

Andrew Jong, HLB Managing Director of Personal Financial Services, said the product recognises the personal stories, sacrifices and ambitions behind client success.

Visa Infinite Privilege Expands Global Access

The privileges attached to the card extend well beyond payments.

HLB opus uses Visa Infinite Privilege, one of Visa’s highest-tier premium offerings.

Clients receive unlimited access to Plaza Premium Lounges around the world.

The package also includes immigration fast-track passes and access to selected Visa private clubs.

Additional status-matching benefits include Harrods Gold, ALL Accor+ Explorer Gold and Banyan Voyager.

These benefits target customers who travel frequently for business and leisure.

Visa Malaysia said affluent consumers are increasingly looking for experiences that feel personal and differentiated.

That shift is pushing premium banking products away from simple cashback and points propositions.

Enrich Partnership Strengthens Travel Rewards

Malaysia Airlines’ Enrich programme plays another important role in the HLB opus ecosystem.

Clients receive 60,000 Enrich Points after payment of the annual fee.

HLB has also created a higher conversion tier designed to reward overseas spending.

The bank says the arrangement gives opus clients the strongest Enrich Points earning potential in the region.

Cardholders can additionally earn one Elite Point for every RM10,000 spent overseas.

Elite Points can help travellers progress through Enrich status tiers.

The partnership also connects customers to reward opportunities across Malaysia Airlines and other carriers in the oneworld alliance.

Malaysia Aviation Group said the collaboration is intended to extend premium service beyond individual flights and into the wider travel experience.

HLB Looks Beyond Traditional Luxury Banking

The introduction of opus reflects changing expectations among affluent banking customers.

Luxury financial products once competed mainly through card materials, airport lounges and concierge services.

Those benefits still matter.

However, wealthy customers increasingly expect banks to understand their wider business, investment and personal needs.

HLB appears to be responding by combining multiple banking divisions around the same client.

That can create deeper relationships and make it harder for competitors to win individual parts of a customer’s financial business.

For HLB, the value of opus may therefore extend far beyond spending on the card itself.

Wealth Management Remains a Key Growth Area

HLB has been expanding its wealth capabilities alongside its business and corporate banking operations.

The bank’s Private Bank works with international wealth partners including Lombard Odier.

That gives HLB access to broader investment and wealth-management expertise for high-net-worth clients.

HLB opus adds a lifestyle layer on top of those capabilities.

The strategy allows the bank to follow a client from business growth through wealth accumulation and eventually into legacy planning.

Premium travel and lifestyle services then become part of that broader relationship.

HLB opus Is Really About Client Retention

The ceramic card may attract attention, but HLB’s larger objective is relationship depth.

An invite-only product gives the bank another way to recognise and retain its highest-value customers.

Premium rewards can strengthen loyalty among clients who already use HLB for corporate, private or personal banking.

At the same time, the exclusivity of the product can reinforce the perceived value of the wider banking relationship.

That makes HLB opus as much a customer strategy as a credit card launch.

Its combination of ceramic design, Visa Infinite Privilege services and Malaysia Airlines rewards gives HLB a distinctive premium proposition.

More importantly, it gives the bank another tool for keeping business, wealth and lifestyle banking under one roof.

title: 'Construction Firm SLGC Ends First Trading Day Below IPO Price
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): SLGC Bhd (KL:SLG) ended its first trading day on the ACE Market below its initial public offering (IPO) price. The construction firm’s shares closed at 25 sen on Tuesday, three sen or 10.71% lower than the IPO price of 28 sen per share, after hitting an intraday low of 24 sen as more than 83 million shares exchanged hands. At the closing price, the company based in Johor had a market capitalisation of RM140 million. Ahead of the listing, SLGC shares were oversubscribed by just over three times by retail investors, while a portion of the IPO was undersubscribed and had to be reallocated to other investors. “Now that SLGC is a listed company, the priority for us is to continue strengthening the business while staying disciplined in how we grow and we intend to keep improving on how we deliver,” managing director Yong Zheng Lin said in his speech at the listing ceremony. SLGC is a building construction contractor with G7 grade and got its start in 2009 under the name SLG Construction Sdn Bhd before being incorporated in 2024. The company also has an operations office in Taman Gembira, Kuala Lumpur. The company is mainly involved in design and building construction services for residential and non-residential works. SLGC's customers include property developers and building owners in Malaysia. The IPO raised about RM29.4 million for the company and another RM17.64 million for four selling shareholders that include Yong and his wife Chew Ka Yan. Liong Yang Herng, the company’s project director, and contract director Loo Chun Kok are also cashing out part of their stake in SLGC. The company has allocated RM9.2 million of the IPO proceeds towards acquisition of construction machinery and equipment, RM7.6 million to repay bank borrowings, and RM7.5 million for general working capital. The rest will cover software upgrades and listing expenses. M&A Securities Sdn Bhd acted as the principal adviser, sponsor, underwriter, and placement agent for the IPO. title: 'Top Glove Expects An Even Better FY2027 After Strong FY2026
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): Top Glove Corporation Bhd (KL:TOPGLOV) expects an even better FY2027 after its net profit tripled in the financial year ended Aug 31, 2026 (FY2026). Top Glove executive chairman Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai said the group’s performance in FY2027 is expected to track global market demand growth of around 10%. "For FY2027 and ahead, we should be able to sustain and should be able to do better...the profit growth or sales growth should be about 10%, following the market growth," Lim said during the group's financial briefing following the release of its fourth-quarter results. "If we work harder and smarter, we should grow even better than 10% of the market growth rate…very likely that we will do better than FY2026," he added. Despite the optimistic outlook, the group faces operational headwinds from rising raw material costs, driven by persistent volatility in crude oil prices from the prolonged Iran war, and the hike in natural gas tariffs starting Oct 1. Top Glove joint managing director Ng Yong Lin said the 30% gas tariff hike is set to increase the group's cost per 1,000 pieces by 50 to 70 US cents (about RM2 to RM2.86), or 2% or 3%. However, the group was confident it could navigate these material cost pressures in FY2027 through disciplined cost and energy saving efforts. Ng said the group had reduced its energy consumption per 1,000 gloves by 30% to 35% compared to 2019 levels and expects automation and AI technology to cushion margins. To offset the rising raw material and gas expenses, the group is increasing average selling prices (ASPs) by US$2 to US$4 per 1,000 pieces for October and November. Currently, generic nitrile glove prices hover around US$21 to US$22 per 1,000 pieces. "So for the month of October, November, we have adjusted the glove selling price by about two to three dollars or even four dollars and that will be enough to cover other costs that increase," Lim said, adding that order books for October and November remain strong despite the price revisions. On competition from China glove manufacturers, Lim said the cost and pricing gap between Malaysian and Chinese makers has narrowed compared to three to four years ago. "The price difference for gloves sold from Malaysia compared to China used to have a big gap of about three to four dollars. Now, Malaysian manufacturers like us have improved our costing well. So our glove costing and selling prices are very close to theirs…there is not much difference anymore," Lim said. He added that attempts by some Chinese manufacturers to expand production into Southeast Asian nations such as Vietnam and Indonesia face operational challenges, including higher raw material import costs and reliance on Chinese expatriate staff, resulting in production costs increases of 10%. "Competition is there, but not as tough as two, three years ago," Lim said. For FY2026, the group's revenue grew 21% to RM4.23 billion from FY2025, supported by a 28% increase in sales volume. Net profit for the full year stood at RM308 million. Top Glove shares closed nine sen higher or 11.46% at 87.5 sen on Tuesday, giving the group a market capitalisation of RM7.2 billion. It was the second most active stock on Bursa Malaysia with 165.13 million shares changing hands. title: 'Berjaya Says Core Berjaya Hills Businesses Unaffected by Pahang Enforcement Action
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): Berjaya Corp Bhd (KL:BJCORP) said its main businesses at Berjaya Hills remain fully operational despite enforcement action by the Pahang authorities, and expects no material financial or operational impact from the issue. It said state authorities had sealed and restricted access to the staff quarters, central laundry, rabbit park and Japanese garden on Sept 28, while The Chateau Spa & Wellness Resort, Colmar Tropicale Hotel, Berjaya Hills Golf & Country Club and the greenhouses were unaffected. "The group's core operating facilities, including the hotels, golf club and greenhouses remain unaffected and continue to operate as usual," Berjaya Corp said in a bourse filing Tuesday. The disclosure was made in response to Bursa Malaysia's queries seeking details of the enforcement action — linked to a long-running dispute between Berjaya Hills Resort Bhd and the Pahang government over a sharp increase in quit rent imposed on the company's properties in the state — and how it would financially and operationally affect the group. Berjaya Hills claimed its annual quit rent jumped 13-fold to RM33.7 million in 2020 from about RM2.4 million in 2019, before being reduced to RM25.75 million following 11 appeals to the state government between April 2020 and December 2022. The company said it paid about RM42.65 million in quit rent and penalties "under protest" between 2020 and 2026, while continuing to seek a further review of the rates. In Tuesday's filing, Berjaya Corp said the higher quit rent expenses had been recognised through accruals for the respective financial years since the revised rates took effect in 2020. "Accordingly, the impact arising from the revised annual quit rent rates has been taken into account in the group's financial statements for the respective financial years and the revised rates have no material operational impact to the group," it added. Separately on Tuesday, Pahang Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Wan Rosdy Wan Ismail said the state government is open to discussions with Berjaya Hills to resolve the impasse, but stressed that any talks must be guided by existing legal provisions and regulations. "That is up to them (Berjaya Hills). We are taking actions based on the law. The state government is open to discussions, but they must be based on and guided by the law. There are regulations, so follow the rules," Wan Rosdy was quoted as saying by Bernama. It said state authorities had sealed and restricted access to the staff quarters, central laundry, rabbit park and Japanese garden on Sept 28, while The Chateau Spa & Wellness Resort, Colmar Tropicale Hotel, Berjaya Hills Golf & Country Club and the greenhouses were unaffected. "The group's core operating facilities, including the hotels, golf club and greenhouses remain unaffected and continue to operate as usual," Berjaya Corp said in a bourse filing Tuesday. The disclosure was made in response to Bursa Malaysia's queries seeking details of the enforcement action — linked to a long-running dispute between Berjaya Hills Resort Bhd and the Pahang government over a sharp increase in quit rent imposed on the company's properties in the state — and how it would financially and operationally affect the group. title: 'PublicInvest Research Headlines - 7 Oct 2026
body: 'US: Trade deficit widens as imports hit record high. The US trade deficit widened more than expected in August as strong domestic demand drove imports to an all-time high, suggesting trade could again weigh on third-quarter economic growth despite higher tariffs. The deficit increased 13.7% to USD105.6bn, the largest since March 2025, compared with economists' expectations of USD102.0bn. (Reuters) EU: High yields may dampen energy inflation pass-through, ECB's Rehn says. Rapid energy inflation in the euro zone has yet to spread significantly into other goods and services, while higher bond yields could restrain growth and reduce the transmission of energy costs into broader prices and wages, ECB policymaker Olli Rehn said. Euro-zone inflation remains well above the ECB's 2% target, but policymakers are weighing persistent energy-driven price pressures against tighter financial conditions. Long-term yields have risen to more than decade highs amid higher US yields and European debt concerns. Financial markets currently price another two to three ECB rate increases during the tightening cycle, including around an 80% probability of a move by December. (Reuters) UK: High inflation has become embedded, BoE's Mann says. Inflation above the BoE's 2% target appears to have become embedded in the UK economy and could become further entrenched through wage negotiations early next year, BoE policymaker Catherine Mann said. Unlike the Fed and ECB, the BoE has kept rates unchanged since the outbreak of the Iran war, although markets now expect a rate increase in November. Mann highlighted the risk of inflation reaching around 4% near year-end, coinciding with the period when many employers negotiate annual pay increases. She said demand remained positive but not particularly strong, while businesses were adapting to elevated energy costs. (Reuters) China: Zinc exports surge as weak domestic demand leaves excess supply. China is on course to become a net exporter of refined zinc this year as soft domestic construction demand coincides with tight supply conditions in Western markets. Zinc exports jumped to 40,668 tonnes in August, the second-highest monthly level in almost two decades, while China recorded net exports of 4,388 tonnes during the first eight months of the year. Muted construction activity has weakened demand for galvanised steel, leaving Shanghai zinc inventories elevated, while an arbitrage opportunity created by tight London Metal Exchange supply has encouraged Chinese exports. (Reuters) Japan: BOJ signals readiness for further rate hikes to anchor inflation. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said it was becoming increasingly important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2% target, signalling readiness to continue raising interest rates to prevent inflation from overshooting. Economic and price developments remain broadly consistent with BOJ forecasts, while the Tankan survey points to solid business sentiment. Rising raw-material costs are feeding into wholesale and consumer inflation, while long-term inflation expectations continue to rise. Ueda also cited risks from the Iran war, strong AI-related demand and a weak yen, adding that financial conditions remain accommodative even after September's rate increase. (Reuters) India: Markets price RBI hike, with risk of larger move. The RBI could tighten monetary policy more aggressively than expected as policymakers face broadening price pressures and sharply higher global bond yields. The one-month overnight indexed swap was around 5.55%, about 30bps above the current 5.25% repo rate, implying a 25bps hike is fully priced in while leaving some probability of a 50bps increase. Most economists polled by Reuters expect a 25bps hike, which would be the RBI's first rate increase since early 2023. Bankers estimate markets may be assigning roughly a 25% probability to a larger move.(Reuters) CIMB (Outperform, TP: RM8.70): Considers selling Philippine business. CIMB Group Holdings is exploring a sale of its business in the Philippines as part of efforts to streamline and focus on bigger markets for growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter. (Bloomberg) Comments: According to Bloomberg, the deal could value the business at USD200m. While historically CIMB Philippine's contribution to the group is minimal and has swung into losses in 2025, we think that the potential sale is in-line with the group's strategy to redeploy capital into higher-return segments, which could potentially support ROE expansion. We maintain our Outperform call with an unchanged TP of RM8.70. Dialog (Neutral, TP: RM2.10): JV bags onshore O&G concession in Thailand. Dialog Group said its 50.01%-owned joint venture company has been awarded concession rights and operatorship for the L8/66 exploration block onshore Thailand. (The Edge) Comments: We view the L8/66 concession award positively, given its proximity to Dialog's producing L53/48 fields and the ability to leverage existing facilities and operating expertise to optimise development costs. The USD14.3m minimum work commitment over six years provides measured exposure to potential reserve and production growth, with management indicating a low-to-mid-teens projected IRR. However, we leave our earnings forecasts unchanged as the project remains at a preliminary stage. We maintain our Neutral call with an unchanged TP of RM2.10. Zetrix: Says still finalising amount owed to JPJ after Loke reveals RM314m arrears. Zetrix AI said the exact amount it owes the Road Transport Department (JPJ) is still being finalised between the two parties, a day after Transport Minister Anthony Loke Siew Fook said the company had accumulated RM314m in unpaid remittances. (The Edge) Samaiden: Reveals RM238m contract value for LSS5+ solar project. Samaiden Group said its contracts to undertake works for a 99.99-megawatt (MW) Large Scale Solar 5+ (LSS5+) project are worth RM238m. Samaiden's had on Oct 2 entered into a works contract and a contract for the supply of solar components with Syarikat Pembenaan Yeoh Tiong Lay SB (YTL Construction), the construction unit of YTL Corporation. (The Edge) Mesiniaga: Wins two-year RM32.3m contract extension from Customs Dept. Mesiniaga has won a RM32.3m contract from the Royal Malaysian Customs Department (RMDC) for the maintenance and licence renewal of its MyGST System. The contract marks a continuation of the information technology product and service provider's earlier MyGST system agreement with RMCD that first started in Nov 2023. (The Edge) OCK: Taps Phu Quoc infrastructure opportunities. OCK Group has signed a tripartite in-principle agreement with Southern Star Telecommunication Equipment Joint Stock Company (SPN), a subsidiary of JTOWER, and Sun Phu Quoc, a subsidiary of Sun Group, to deploy telecommunications infrastructure across designated Sun Group projects in Phu Quoc. (StarBiz) The KLCI might open stronger today as the S&P 500 climbed 0.6% Tuesday to a record after topping its prior all-time high set in August. Despite worries about everything from war to high inflation to pressure from the bond market, the index at the heart of many 401(k) accounts has soared 23% since hitting a bottom in late March. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 253 points, or 0.5%, while the Nasdaq composite tacked 0.4% onto its own all-time high set the day before. The record-high stock prices are helping investors feel better about their finances, or at least less bad, when Americans are generally feeling discouraged about keeping up with the fast-rising cost of living. Many of the fears that sent the US stock market to its bottom in March have indeed come true. Oil prices are high because of the war with Iran, which has made inflation worse. Yields have cranked higher in the bond market, which threatens to slow the economy by making it more expensive for everyone to borrow money. And Americans broadly say they're feeling more pessimistic about the economy and where it's heading. But one vital source of support has remained resolute for the US stock market throughout: the relentless ability for companies to make more money. AI stocks have been a huge force driving the US market to records, including Nvidia's 28.3% surge so far this year. That's roughly double the broad market's gain. Constellation Energy jumped 12.2% for one of Tuesday's biggest gains in the S&P 500 because it's also riding that rising tide. Bond yields offered some slack on Tuesday after falling back from their highest levels in years or even decades. The yield on the 10-year Treasury, which is the focal point of the US bond market, eased to 5.28% from 5.31% late Monday. It fell after oil prices steadied themselves somewhat. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil, the international standard, dropped to roughly $97 in the morning before pulling back to settle at $100.58. While that was up 0.3% from Monday's settlement price, it's still below the nearly $110 it was at a few weeks ago. In stock markets abroad, indices ticked higher in Europe as yields continue to swing in their bond markets amid concerns about high government debts and tight budgets. In France, tens of thousands of demonstrators marched in support of protests by students demanding more funding for schools. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 jumped 1.1%, and Hong Kong's Hang Seng climbed 1%, but South Korea's Kospi dropped 0.9%. Back home, the KLCI added 1.6 points or 0.1% to 1,633.35. title: 'CIMB, Zetrix AI, Top Glove, Samaiden, Mesiniaga, Scientex, Dialog, Elridge Energy, Insights Analytics, SLGC
body: 'CIMB, Zetrix AI, Top Glove, Samaiden, Mesiniaga, Scientex, Dialog, Elridge Energy, Insights Analytics, SLGC KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 7): Here is a brief recap of some business news and corporate announcements that made the headlines on Tuesday: CIMB Group Holdings Bhd (KL:CIMB) is exploring a sale of its business in the Philippines as part of efforts to streamline and focus on bigger markets for growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter. The Malaysian lender is working with a financial adviser on the potential divestment and has reached out to prospective buyers to gauge interest, said the people. A deal could value the business at as much as US$200 million (RM817 million). — CIMB considers selling Philippine business — Bloomberg Zetrix AI Bhd (KL:ZETRIX) said the exact amount it owes the Road Transport Department (JPJ) is still being finalised between the two parties, a day after Transport Minister Anthony Loke Siew Fook said the company had accumulated RM314 million in unpaid remittances. In response to queries from Bursa Malaysia, the group reiterated that it had submitted a payment proposal to settle the arrears, and that the final sum and settlement terms remain subject to further discussions and formal agreement with authorities. — Zetrix says still finalising amount owed to JPJ after Loke reveals RM314m arrears Top Glove Corporation Bhd (KL:TOPGLOV) said labour shortage remains a primary constraint in scaling up production as it seeks to capture rising global demand following its best year since 2021. The group is targeting to raise annual running capacity by 8% to 78 billion pieces in the financial year ending Aug 31, 2027 (FY2027), from 72 billion in FY2026. The group’s net profit jumped nearly five times to RM157.63 million in the three months ended Aug 31, 2026 (4QFY2026) from RM34.83 million in the same quarter a year earlier. Revenue for the quarter surged 40% year-on-year to RM1.25 billion. A final dividend of 1.50 sen per share was also declared for FY2026 and payable on Dec 15. For the full FY2026, Top Glove’s net profit nearly tripled to RM307.96 million. Revenue increased 21% to RM4.23 billion as volume grew close to 30%. — Top Glove eyes higher output but says manpower remains key hurdle;Top Glove says ready for storms ahead as 4Q net profit jumps nearly five times Samaiden Group Bhd (KL:SAMAIDEN) said its contracts to undertake works for a 99.99-megawatt (MW) Large Scale Solar 5+ (LSS5+) project are worth RM238 million. Samaiden's wholly-owned subsidiary Samaiden Sdn Bhd had on Oct 2 entered into a works contract and a contract for the supply of solar components with Syarikat Pembenaan Yeoh Tiong Lay Sdn Bhd (YTL Construction), the construction unit of YTL Corporation Bhd (KL:YTL). The project is among the LSS5+ projects approved by the Energy Commission in September 2025. — Samaiden reveals RM238 mil contract value for LSS5+ solar project Mesiniaga Bhd (KL:MSNIAGA) has won a RM32.3 million contract from the Royal Malaysian Customs Department (RMDC) for the maintenance and licence renewal of its MyGST System. The contract marks a continuation of the information technology product and service provider’s earlier MyGST system agreement with RMCD that first started in November 2023. The new extension, which takes effect from Oct 16, 2026, will run until Oct 15, 2028. — Mesiniaga wins two-year RM32.3m contract extension from Customs Dept Scientex Bhd (KL:SCIENTX) is acquiring 503 acres in Pulai, Johor, for RM580 million to boost the property developer’s land bank. The plan is to turn the 14 plots of land currently owned by the Lau family of Leong Hup International Bhd (KL:LHI) into mixed development, the company said. However, it is too early to determine development value and other details, it noted. — Scientex to acquire 503 acres in Johor for RM580 mil Dialog Group Bhd (KL:DIALOG) said its 50.01%-owned joint venture company has been awarded concession rights and operatorship for the L8/66 exploration block onshore Thailand. The joint venture company, Pan Orient Energy (Siam) Ltd (POES), was notified by the Thai government on Oct 5 that it had been awarded the concession following a joint bid with CanAsia Energy Corp in Thailand’s 25th Onshore Bid Round. POES will operate the concession with a 70% participating interest, while Canada-listed CanAsia will hold the remaining 30% non-operating interest. — Dialog JV bags onshore O&G concession in Thailand Elridge Energy Holdings Bhd (KL:ELRIDGE) is investing RM45 million to venture into the manufacturing and sale of activated carbon business for use across water treatment, industrial purification and related filtration. This marks Elridge's move further downstream from its existing palm kernel shell biomass operations. title: 'Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi sejajar sentimen positif serantau
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi hari ini, sejajar dengan peningkatan dalam kebanyakan pasaran utama Asia susulan kenaikan saham teknologi di Wall Street dalam tempoh semalaman, walaupun hasil bon Perbendaharaan Amerika Syarikat (AS) yang tinggi terus mengehadkan minat terhadap risiko. Pada 5 petang, FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) meningkat 1.60 mata kepada 1,633.35 berbanding 1,631.75 semasa ditutup pada Isnin. Indeks petunjuk pasaran itu yang dibuka 4.63 mata lebih tinggi kepada 1,636.38, bergerak antara 1,632.77 dan 1,641.20 sepanjang sesi dagangan. Dalam pasaran secara menyeluruh, kaunter untung mengatasi kaunter rugi sebanyak 667 berbanding 456 manakala 551 kaunter tidak berubah, 1,108 tidak diniagakan dan 13 yang lain digantung dagangan. Jumlah dagangan susut kepada 4.18 bilion unit bernilai RM2.95 bilion berbanding 4.78 bilion unit bernilai RM2.89 bilion semalam. Naib Presiden Penyelidikan Ekuiti Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd, Thong Pak Leng, berkata hasil bon Perbendaharaan AS dalam tempoh 10 tahun mencecah 5.349 peratus, paras tertinggi sejak 2002 manakala hasil bon 30 tahun meningkat seketika kepada 5.703 peratus. Semasa ditutup pada Isnin, S&P 500 meningkat 0.66 peratus kepada 7,773.95 mata manakala Indeks Komposit Nasdaq naik 1.05 peratus kepada 27,477.31 mata. "Dari sudut positif, harga minyak mentah Brent menyusut di bawah AS$100 setong apabila eksport Asia Barat yang kekal kukuh serta pelepasan stok simpanan kecemasan oleh negara-negara Kumpulan Tujuh (G7) membantu mengurangkan kebimbangan terhadap bekalan," katanya kepada Bernama. Menurutnya di dalam negara, minat belian dapat dilihat dalam saham telekomunikasi dan berkaitan komoditi manakala aktiviti dagangan turut meluas kepada beberapa kaunter teknologi bermodal kecil, tenaga dan perladangan. "Kami yakin bahawa saham mewah terpilih boleh terus menarik aktiviti pembelian saham ketika harga rendah susulan pembetulan yang ketara minggu lalu. Bagaimanapun, ketiadaan pembelian susulan sepanjang tiga sesi dagangan lepas menunjukkan pelabur terus berwaspada, dengan jualan berterusan oleh pelabur asing dan hasil bon yang tinggi dijangka mengehadkan kadar pemulihan," katanya. Sementara itu, Thong berkata, penurunan harga minyak mentah dan harapan mengenai Belanjawan 2027 dijangka memberikan sedikit sokongan kepada sentimen. "Belanjawan akan dibentangkan pada Jumaat, dengan sektor strategik termasuk semikonduktor, kecerdasan buatan, pendigitalan, peralihan tenaga, farmaseutikal, logistik dan aeroangkasa antara bidang yang diberi tumpuan oleh kerajaan," katanya. Bagi tempoh yang masih berbaki minggu ini, beliau menjangkakan indeks petunjuk pasaran itu kekal dalam fasa konsolidasi dengan kecenderungan untuk pulih secara sederhana apabila situasi terlebih jual memberikan sedikit sokongan kepada pasaran daripada penurunan selanjutnya. "Bagaimanapun, pemulihan yang lebih kukuh mungkin memerlukan pemangkin baharu, dengan Belanjawan 2027, aliran dana asing, hasil bon dan perkembangan geopolitik kekal sebagai faktor utama untuk diberikan perhatian. "Kami mengekalkan julat dagangan FBM KLCI pada 1,620 hingga 1,650 mata bagi minggu ini," katanya. Antara saham wajaran tinggi, IHH Healthcare meningkat 15 sen kepada RM7.91 manakala Maybank dan CIMB masing-masing susut tiga sen kepada RM9.97 dan RM7.70. Public Bank turun empat sen kepada RM4.67 manakala Tenaga Nasional susut 10 sen kepada RM12.90. Bagi saham aktif, Zetrix AI dan Supermax masing-masing meningkat 2.5 sen kepada sembilan sen dan 46 sen, Top Glove menokok sembilan sen kepada 87.5 sen, V.S Industry naik satu sen kepada 33 sen manakala SLGC yang baru disenaraikan di Pasaran ACE susut tiga sen kepada 25 sen. Antara kaunter paling untung, Malaysian Pacific Industries meningkat RM1.56 kepada RM44.96, Nestle naik RM1.26 kepada RM91.26, Pentamaster melonjak 64 sen kepada RM6.08, Mi Technovation menokok 59 sen kepada RM6.00 manakala Kuala Lumpur Kepong naik 46 sen kepada RM21.32. Kaunter paling rugi diterajui Dutch Lady Milk Industries yang susut 30 sen kepada RM29.70, Allianz turun 18 sen kepada RM20.62, TIME dotCom susut 16 sen kepada RM5.45 manakala Mega First Corporation dan Ayer Holdings masing-masing rendah 15 sen kepada RM2.85 dan RM7.55. Di papan indeks, Indeks FBM Mid 70 melonjak 190.62 mata kepada 17,734.11, Indeks FBM Emas meningkat 42.52 mata kepada 12,232.87, Indeks FBM Top 100 naik 42.40 mata kepada 12,015.78, Indeks FBM Emas Syariah meningkat 89.97 mata kepada 12,158.98 manakala Indeks FBM ACE melonjak 52.31 mata kepada 5,658.92. Mengikut sektor, Indeks Produk dan Perkhidmatan Perindustrian meningkat 1.44 mata kepada 180.41 namun Indeks Perkhidmatan Kewangan susut 72.14 mata kepada 19,068.0. Indeks Tenaga pula meningkat 10.78 mata kepada 840.72 manakala Indeks Perladangan melonjak 111.14 mata kepada 9,042.17. Jumlah dagangan Pasaran Utama susut kepada 2.59 bilion unit bernilai RM2.50 bilion daripada 3.13 bilion unit bernilai RM2.41 bilion pada Isnin. Jumlah dagangan waran turun kepada 932.44 juta unit bernilai RM171.80 juta daripada 1.04 bilion unit bernilai RM208.20 juta semalam. Jumlah dagangan Pasaran ACE meningkat kepada 653.91 juta unit bernilai RM276.54 juta daripada 611.02 juta unit bernilai RM267.66 juta sebelum ini. Sementara itu, kaunter produk dan perkhidmatan pengguna menyumbang sebanyak 204.53 juta saham yang didagangkan di Pasaran Utama, produk dan perkhidmatan perindustrian (298.70 juta), pembinaan (102.12 juta), teknologi (1.32 bilion), perkhidmatan kewangan (58.39 juta), hartanah (113.14 juta), perladangan (17.37 juta), amanah pelaburan hartanah (12.12 juta), dana tertutup (45,000), tenaga (69.91 juta), penjagaan kesihatan (294.68 juta), telekomunikasi dan media (25.52 juta), pengangkutan dan logistik (38.51 juta), utiliti (36.68 juta), dan amanah perniagaan (59,700).

title: 'Bursa Malaysia dibuka tinggi berikutan momentum positif Wall Street
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia dibuka tinggi pada Selasa, seiring dengan momentum positif Wall Street semalaman, memandangkan harga minyak yang terkawal susulan pemulihan eksport minyak mentah dari Asia Barat, mengimbangi trend penjualan berterusan dalam pasaran bon Perbendaharaan AS. Pada 9.10 pagi, FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) meningkat 7.14 mata atau 0.44 peratus kepada 1,638.89 berbanding paras 1,631.75 ketika ditutup pada Isnin. Indeks utama itu dibuka 4.63 mata lebih tinggi kepada 1,636.38. Sentimen pasaran secara keseluruhan positif dengan kaunter untung mengatasi kaunter rugi sebanyak 272 berbanding 202, sebanyak 364 kaunter tidak berubah, 1,944 tidak diniagakan dan 13 digantung dagangan. Jumlah dagangan berjumlah 440.19 juta saham bernilai RM164.76 juta. Malacca Securities Sdn Bhd memaklumkan bahawa prestasi positif Wall Street semalaman menyaksikan Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500 dan Nasdaq Composite masing-masing meningkat sebanyak 0.2 peratus, 0.7 peratus dan 1.1 peratus, manakala harga minyak mentah Brent dan hasil Perbendaharaan 10 tahun masing-masing mencecah US$100.3 setong dan 5.3 peratus. "Di peringkat tempatan, kami menjangkakan pelabur akan terus bersikap selektif menjelang pengumuman Belanjawan 2027, dengan tumpuan diberikan kepada sektor-sektor yang berpotensi mendapat manfaat. "Syarikat-syarikat dalam sektor mekanikal dan elektrikal mungkin terus menyaksikan minat belian, disokong oleh penekanan kerajaan terhadap infrastruktur kecerdasan buatan (AI) serta projek tulang belakang Grid Nasional 500-kilovolt Tenaga Nasional Bhd, yang memberi kelebihan kepada syarikat seperti MN Holdings Bhd, Southern Cable Group Bhd dan Powerwell Holdings Bhd," menurut firma itu dalam nota penyelidikan hari ini. Selain itu, Malacca Securities menyatakan bahawa usaha mengurangkan air tanpa hasil (NRW) juga mungkin kekal menjadi tumpuan, berpotensi memberi manfaat kepada syarikat seperti ISF Group Bhd dan Ranhill Utilities Bhd. "Akhir sekali, 99 Speed Mart Retail mungkin menyaksikan minat belian baharu susulan jangkaan peruntukan bantuan pengguna lebih tinggi di bawah Sumbangan Asas Rahmah dan Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah," menurut kenyataan itu. Sementara itu, Naib Presiden Penyelidikan Ekuiti Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd, Thong Pak Leng berkata Wall Street ditutup lebih kukuh, dengan Nasdaq mencatatkan paras tertinggi baharu apabila pedagang memilih untuk tidak mempedulikan cabaran pasaran semasa dan sebaliknya menumpukan perhatian kepada saham berkaitan AI bagi mengimbangi kesan kenaikan hasil bon. "Untuk hari ini, kami menjangkakan indeks akan bergerak dalam julat 1,630-1,640 memandangkan pasaran saham tempatan mungkin bersedia untuk aktiviti pembelian saham pada harga rendah," katanya kepada Bernama. Saham berwajaran tinggi menyaksikan Maybank dan Tenaga Nasional naik empat sen masing-masing kepada RM10.04 dan RM13.04, CIMB menokok tiga sen kepada RM7.76, IHH Healthcare menambah dua sen kepada RM7.78, manakala Public Bank tidak berubah pada RM4.71. Bagi saham aktif, Zetrix AI melonjak setengah sen kepada tujuh sen, Divfex naik satu sen kepada 16.5 sen, Ramssol meningkat 2.5 sen kepada 86 sen, manakala SLGC yang baru disenaraikan di Pasaran ACE susut 3.5 sen kepada 24.5 sen, dan Dagang NeXchange merosot sentengah sen kepada 50 sen. title: 'Carbon Tax Deferment Gives Ministry More Time to Finalise Regulatory, Policy Framework, Says Arthur
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 5): The deferment of the carbon tax implementation is aligned with the Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Ministry’s efforts to establish a complete regulatory and policy framework before enforcing emission caps. Minister Datuk Seri Arthur Joseph Kurup said the government decided to delay the tax, originally planned for this year, following global geopolitical developments that led to volatile energy prices, providing affected industries with a necessary buffer. Speaking during a Concorde Club dialogue session at Wisma Bernama on Monday, he said the postponement is also timely as the ministry works towards solidifying the required legal structure, including the National Carbon Market Policy and the upcoming Climate Change Act. “[The postponement] is also right because we need to have the proper framework and all that in place first. That’s why we’ve been successful in launching the National Carbon Market Policy and I hope that we can table the Climate Change Act soon. “Once that is up, then we have the framework and the policies all clearly in place, including the regulation, enforcement, the regulatory powers to give us to set the emission ceiling, and then we can know anything above the ceiling, then the carbon tax will come into place as a penalty to the polluters. “So, we’re not looking at this year for the carbon tax,” he said. Meanwhile, on Clean Air Regulations exemption, Arthur said exemptions for industrial plants under the regulation would only be extended to factory operators who demonstrate proactive measures toward technology adoption. He said while no new blanket extensions are being issued, factory operators whose exemptions expire by January next year must show clear steps toward compliance, with 2030 set as the final deadline for total compliance across all industries. “We had the Clean Air Regulations, which came into force in 2014, where plants, factories are not allowed to pollute above the 600 milligram per cubic metre...that was the regulation set...however, they have been enjoying exemptions up to this year. “So when I came in as the minister, I decided that I will not be issuing any more exemptions because the technology is available, the technology is accessible and if we are to meet our target of net zero emissions by 2050, we need to have all this in place and we definitely need the cooperation from the industries as well,” he said. He added that while operators need adequate time for feasibility studies and modifications, strict progress is required to qualify for temporary extensions. The session, titled “Building A Resilient Malaysia: Environment, Climate And Our Future”, was moderated by Bernama chairman Datuk Seri Wong Chun Wai. Also present was Bernama chief executive officer Datin Paduka Nur-ul Afida Kamaludin, as well as members of the local and foreign media based in Malaysia. title: 'PN Challenging Suspension in Court, Seeks Expedited Hearing as Melaka Polls Loom
body: 'PUTRAJAYA (Oct 5): Perikatan Nasional on Monday filed a legal challenge against its suspension and potential deregistration by the Registrar of Societies (RoS), and is seeking an expedited hearing to resolve the matter before the Melaka election. PN secretary-general Datuk Seri Takiyuddin Hassan said the coalition wants to quash notices issued by RoS under Sections 13(2) and 13(2A) of the Societies Act 1966. Section 13(2) requires PN to explain its actions within 30 days or be deregistered. The Section 13(2A) notice informs PN that it must suspend its activities until it has responded to the matter. The suspension means PN cannot use its logo during the state polls. “The only reason given [for the notice and suspension] was that we did not invite Bersatu leaders for a meeting on July 16. But the official complaint by Bersatu was never given to us,” Takiyuddin, who is also secretary-general of PAS, said at a press conference on Monday. PN's application names RoS director-general Datuk Muhammad Zulfikar Ahmad and Home Minister Datuk Seri Datuk Sri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail as respondents. The Election Commission (EC) is expected to announce the date of the Melaka election after a meeting on Wednesday. The state polls must be held within 60 days of the Sept 23 dissolution of the Melaka assembly. Given the urgency, Takiyuddin said the coalition has also made a filing requesting that the case be expedited. “We want to ask the court to hear this case urgently because we need the court’s determination before the Melaka election is held,” he said. Takiyuddin said the coalition had engaged with the EC on this matter but the final word lay with the RoS. Asked whether PN component parties would use their own logos in the Melaka polls, Takiyuddin said: “These five parties, PAS, Wawasan, Gerakan, MIPP and Pejuang, have been negotiating that matter in view of all possibilities.” The suspension of PN comes after PAS said on June 8 it had ended political cooperation with Bersatu, the previously the dominant party in PN. title: 'Mustapha Proposes Committee to Work Out Mechanism for Sabah, Sarawak Parliamentary Seat Increase
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 5): Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Sabah and Sarawak) Datuk Mustapha Sakmud has proposed the establishment of a special committee under the Technical Committee of the Malaysia Agreement 1963 Implementation Action Council (MTPMA63) to work out the mechanism for increasing parliamentary seats for Sabah and Sarawak. He also proposed that the special committee be co-chaired by him and Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Law and Institutional Reform) Datuk Seri Azalina Othman Said. “The increase in the number of members of Parliament from Sabah and Sarawak has been included in the agenda of MTPMA63 and its Technical Committee meetings, and has also been discussed extensively at Cabinet meetings. “Following the decision, I held preliminary discussions with the Election Commission (EC) to seek its views and determine the next course of action,” he said during the question-and-answer session in the Dewan Rakyat on Monday. He said this in response to a supplementary question from Datuk Willie Mongin (GPS-Puncak Borneo), who sought clarification on the mechanisms and legislative steps required to increase parliamentary seats for the two states. Mustapha said discussions on the matter would continue at upcoming meetings of the MTPMA63 Technical Committee. Meanwhile, he said 13 of the 26 matters under the MTPMA63 negotiation platform had been categorised as resolved, following decisions made at the first MTPMA63 meeting held on Sept 11. “Of the 26 matters, three have been categorised as partially resolved, five remain unresolved, while another five have been brought before the prime minister, the Sarawak premier and the Sabah chief minister for discussion,” he said. Mustapha said the MA63-related matters brought before the highest level for discussion and decision-making included oil royalties and petroleum cash payments, stamp duties, the Territorial Sea Act 2012, and state rights over the continental shelf. He said the Madani government was committed to expediting the resolution of all claims under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 (MA63), although the timeframe for resolving each claim was subject to the relevant legal processes. “The Madani government remains firmly committed to ensuring the prudent and inclusive implementation of MA63, grounded in the spirit of strong federalism,” he said. title: 'BT Buys Over TalkTalk to Save UK's Broadband Provider From Collapse
body: '(Oct 5): BT Group plc bought TalkTalk and PlatformX Communications Ltd out of administration, preventing the collapse of a UK broadband provider that is also a major customer. The deal, which is expected to have a total cash impact of £400 million (RM2.16 billion) for the 2027 fiscal year, was made “in the public interest” after talks to sell TalkTalk’s consumer and wholesale businesses fell through, BT said in a statement on Monday. “This is a genuinely unprecedented situation, where millions of citizens and businesses were at risk if TalkTalk had collapsed,” BT chief executive officer Allison Kirkby said in the statement. “Our immediate priority is to stabilise the business and provide a safety net for the households and businesses who rely on TalkTalk.” TalkTalk has struggled under its debt load since it was bought out in 2021 by Toscafund Asset Management LLP and private equity firm Penta Capital. The company was founded as a low-cost broadband provider, reselling wholesale access on BT’s Openreach network to consumers. However, high levels of competition and persistent inflation undermined its business. The deal will pay off after TalkTalk’s business stabilises and the companies combine operations, according to BT, which maintained its financial targets. BT shares rose 1.5% to 199.2 pence at 8.56am in London. TalkTalk ended talks with Octopus Investments to sell its wholesale network division, Sky News reported last month. That came after discussions with the private equity firm Epiris didn’t result in a deal. The two companies will continue to work separately while regulators review the deal. TalkTalk, which has lost customers in recent years, was the UK’s fourth-biggest broadband provider with an 8% market share, according to a 2025 Ofcom report. BT, formerly the UK’s phone monopoly, was the largest with a 30% share. UK State Secretary for digital Lisa Nandy will weigh wider public interest when reviewing the Competition and Markets Authority’s report on antitrust concerns. Critical infrastructure, including emergency services and hospital communications rely on TalkTalk’s services, Nandy’s department said in a statement. Kirkby sought government assurances beforehand that a takeover of TalkTalk would not trigger an in-depth antitrust review, the Financial Times reported previously. Over the last year, TalkTalk reported revenues of about £1.2 billion and was loss-making. The company has about 1.5 million retail customers and one million wholesale customers in the UK. title: 'Pintu itu terbuka pada tahun 2018. Ia boleh terbuka semula
body: 'Pada malam 9 Mei 2018, saya berada di rumah, terpaku di hadapan televisyen. Saya menonton dengan penuh keterujaan yang memuncak tatkala keputusan pilihan raya umum diumumkan sedikit demi sedikit. Menjelang akhir malam itu, pemerintahan selama lebih enam dekad oleh Barisan Nasional dan gabungan pendahulunya, Alliance atau Parti Perikatan, telah berakhir. Buat pertama kalinya, Malaysia menukar kerajaan persekutuannya menerusi peti undi. Rakyat telah memilih kerajaan Pakatan Harapan yang menjanjikan reformasi yang sekian lama dinanti-nantikan. Bagi ramai antara kita yang telah bertahun-tahun memperjuangkan reformasi, ia terasa seolah-olah sebuah keajaiban politik. Kita telah menyaksikan tatanan politik yang sama bertahan mengharungi pilihan raya demi pilihan raya serta protes demi protes. Kini, apa yang dahulunya dianggap mustahil, benar-benar telah berlaku. Sebuah pintu terbuka Perubahan itu membawa harapan. Timbul satu perasaan bahawa akhirnya sebuah pintu telah pun terbuka. Isu-isu yang sekian lama dibangkitkan oleh masyarakat sivil – kebebasan bersuara, akauntabiliti, kedaulatan undang-undang dan kebebasan institusi – tiba-tiba terasa seolah-olah boleh digapai. Namun, jangkaan sering kali dipengaruhi oleh keterujaan pada saat segalanya berlaku. Apabila euforia kian pudar, jelaslah bahawa pertukaran kerajaan dengan sendirinya tidak akan membawa reformasi. - Sign up for Aliran's free daily email updates or weekly newsletters or both - Make a one-off donation to Persatuan Aliran Kesedaran Negara (ALIRAN), Maybank a/c 507246118995 or CIMB a/c 8004240948 - Make a regular pledge or periodic auto-donation to Aliran - Become an Aliran member Undang-undang, institusi dan amalan politik yang telah terbina selama berdekad-dekad tidak akan berubah dalam sekelip mata. Reformasi memerlukan masa, kehendak politik dan tekanan berterusan daripada orang ramai. Bulan-bulan awal kerajaan baharu itu kelihatan menjanjikan. Namun, kemajuan terbantut, dan peristiwa ‘Langkah Sheraton’ pada tahun 2020 menyebabkan kerajaan PH tumbang. Apa yang menyusul kemudian ialah satu tempoh ketidakstabilan politik yang melelahkan. Sebahagian besar harapan pada tahun 2018 akhirnya bertukar menjadi kekecewaan. Pilihan raya umum berikutnya pada bulan November 2022 membuka satu lagi peluang. Namun, tiada gabungan parti yang berjaya memperoleh majoriti. Anwar Ibrahim, yang sekian lama dianggap sebagai wajah gerakan reformasi, dilantik sebagai perdana menteri. ‘Kerajaan perpaduan’ pimpinannya turut merangkumi BN – gabungan yang telah ditentang oleh golongan reformis selama berdekad-dekad. Kembalinya PH ke tampuk kuasa disambut dengan rasa lega selepas bertahun-tahun dilanda ketidaktentuan. Walau bagaimanapun, orang ramai kekal berhati-hati, dan perasaan itu berasas. Boleh difahami jika reformasi mengambil masa. Namun, banyak reformasi yang sekian lama dituntut oleh masyarakat sivil telah ditangguhkan, dilemahkan atau diketepikan. Undang-undang yang bersifat menindas, seperti Akta Hasutan dan Seksyen 233 Akta Komunikasi dan Multimedia, masih terus digunakan. Kadangkala ia digunakan oleh pihak-pihak yang suatu ketika dahulu pernah berkempen menentang undang-undang tersebut. Penahanan pemimpin Mandiri Layanan yang diterima baru-baru ini oleh kumpulan yang diterajui golongan muda, Mandiri, menunjukkan betapa jauh lagi perjalanan yang perlu ditempuhi. Menurut Mandiri, awal bulan ini [September], akaun bank mereka dibekukan dan larangan perjalanan dikenakan tanpa sebarang penjelasan kepada umum. Kemudian, pada 18 September, pihak polis menyerbu pejabat yang dikongsi oleh Mandiri dengan Hayat, sebuah kumpulan yang menentang hukuman mati. Seterusnya, pada 22 September, polis menahan pengarah eksekutif Mandiri, Amir Hariri Abdul Hadi, dan pengarah kewangannya, Dobby Chew, di bawah undang-undang pencegahan pengubahan wang haram. Mereka telah hadir secara sukarela di hadapan pegawai penyiasat untuk memberikan keterangan. Kedua-duanya kemudian dibebaskan, namun siasatan masih diteruskan. Walau apa pun kesudahannya, cara tindakan keras ini dilakukan menghantar mesej yang menggerunkan kepada sesiapa sahaja yang bersuara. Undang-undang yang bertujuan memerangi pengubahan wang haram tidak seharusnya digunakan untuk menakut-nakutkan masyarakat sivil. Perkara ini tidak boleh diterima di bawah kerajaan yang pernah berjanji untuk membuka ruang demokrasi. Pihak berkuasa mesti mendedahkan asas siasatan tersebut serta menarik balik pembekuan akaun dan larangan perjalanan yang dikenakan tanpa penjelasan. Mereka juga mesti menghentikan penggunaan kuasa pencegahan pengubahan wang haram terhadap kumpulan masyarakat sivil. Nampaknya, pertukaran pihak yang memerintah tidak menjamin perubahan dalam cara kuasa digunakan. Itulah sebabnya detik sekarang ini penting. Tekanan terhadap masyarakat sivil bukanlah satu isu terpencil. Ia merupakan sebahagian daripada kerja reformasi demokrasi yang belum selesai. Malah, kemajuan yang perlahan menjadikan peranan masyarakat sivil semakin penting, bukan sebaliknya. Apabila kerajaan bertukar tetapi struktur asas kekal, perlu ada pihak yang bersedia untuk mempersoalkan, meneliti dan menuntut akauntabiliti. Hal ini telah difahami oleh Aliran sejak ditubuhkan pada tahun 1977. Ia terus membangkitkan persoalan mengenai demokrasi, hak asasi manusia dan keadilan sosial di bawah setiap kerajaan yang pernah memerintah Malaysia. Setelah terlibat dengan Aliran selama hampir dua dekad, saya sendiri telah menyaksikan beberapa perubahan tersebut. Saya juga melihat betapa mudahnya untuk berasa tawar hati apabila, selepas bertahun-tahun berjuang, kemajuan tidak sentiasa dicapai sepantas yang kita harapkan. Harapan dalam perjuangan yang panjang Namun, kita juga harus mengingati tahun 2018. Selama bertahun-tahun, perubahan kelihatan mustahil. Kemudian, secara tidak disangka-sangka, ia berlaku. Perkara ini seharusnya membuatkan kita berhati-hati untuk tidak menganggap keadaan hari ini sebagai sesuatu yang kekal. Kita tidak tahu bila perubahan akan berlaku lagi, atau dalam bentuk apa ia akan muncul. Namun, masa depan tidak terikat kepada masa kini. Itulah erti harapan dalam sebuah perjuangan yang panjang. Ia bukanlah satu kepastian bahawa segala-galanya akan menjadi seperti yang kita inginkan. Ia adalah kesedaran bahawa keadaan boleh berubah, dan bahawa apa yang kita lakukan sementara itu penting. Václav Havel menghabiskan masa bertahun-tahun sebagai seorang disiden sebelum menjadi presiden Cekoslovakia yang bebas. Beliau mengungkapkannya begini: harapan “bukanlah keyakinan bahawa sesuatu perkara akan berakhir dengan baik, tetapi kepastian bahawa sesuatu perkara itu bermakna, tidak kira bagaimana kesudahannya nanti.” Perjuangan demi Malaysia yang lebih demokratik sejak awal lagi tidak mungkin dimenangi hanya melalui satu pilihan raya atau satu kerajaan. Pengajaran tahun 2018 bukanlah bahawa perubahan itu mudah. Pengajarannya ialah bahawa perubahan itu boleh berlaku. Dan apabila kemajuan kelihatan perlahan, itu sudah cukup menjadi alasan untuk kita terus melangkah. 'Pintu itu terbuka pada tahun 2018. Ia boleh terbuka semula

'Pada malam 9 Mei 2018, saya berada di rumah, terpaku di hadapan televisyen. Saya menonton dengan penuh keterujaan yang memuncak tatkala keputusan pilihan raya umum diumumkan sedikit demi sedikit. Menjelang akhir malam itu, pemerintahan selama lebih enam dekad oleh Barisan Nasional dan gabungan pendahulunya, Alliance atau Parti Perikatan, telah berakhir. Buat pertama kalinya, Malaysia menukar kerajaan persekutuannya menerusi peti undi. Rakyat telah memilih kerajaan Pakatan Harapan yang menjanjikan reformasi yang sekian lama dinanti-nantikan. Bagi ramai antara kita yang telah bertahun-tahun memperjuangkan reformasi, ia terasa seolah-olah sebuah keajaiban politik. Kita telah menyaksikan tatanan politik yang sama bertahan mengharungi pilihan raya demi pilihan raya serta protes demi protes. Kini, apa yang dahulunya dianggap mustahil, benar-benar telah berlaku. Sebuah pintu terbuka Perubahan itu membawa harapan. Timbul satu perasaan bahawa akhirnya sebuah pintu telah pun terbuka. Isu-isu yang sekian lama dibangkitkan oleh masyarakat sivil – kebebasan bersuara, akauntabiliti, kedaulatan undang-undang dan kebebasan institusi – tiba-tiba terasa seolah-olah boleh digapai. Namun, jangkaan sering kali dipengaruhi oleh keterujaan pada saat segalanya berlaku. Apabila euforia kian pudar, jelaslah bahawa pertukaran kerajaan dengan sendirinya tidak akan membawa reformasi. - Sign up for Aliran's free daily email updates or weekly newsletters or both - Make a one-off donation to Persatuan Aliran Kesedaran Negara (ALIRAN), Maybank a/c 507246118995 or CIMB a/c 8004240948 - Make a regular pledge or periodic auto-donation to Aliran - Become an Aliran member Undang-undang, institusi dan amalan politik yang telah terbina selama berdekad-dekad tidak akan berubah dalam sekelip mata. Reformasi memerlukan masa, kehendak politik dan tekanan berterusan daripada orang ramai. Bulan-bulan awal kerajaan baharu itu kelihatan menjanjikan. Namun, kemajuan terbantut, dan peristiwa ‘Langkah Sheraton’ pada tahun 2020 menyebabkan kerajaan PH tumbang. Apa yang menyusul kemudian ialah satu tempoh ketidakstabilan politik yang melelahkan. Sebahagian besar harapan pada tahun 2018 akhirnya bertukar menjadi kekecewaan. Pilihan raya umum berikutnya pada bulan November 2022 membuka satu lagi peluang. Namun, tiada gabungan parti yang berjaya memperoleh majoriti. Anwar Ibrahim, yang sekian lama dianggap sebagai wajah gerakan reformasi, dilantik sebagai perdana menteri. ‘Kerajaan perpaduan’ pimpinannya turut merangkumi BN – gabungan yang telah ditentang oleh golongan reformis selama berdekad-dekad. Kembalinya PH ke tampuk kuasa disambut dengan rasa lega selepas bertahun-tahun dilanda ketidaktentuan. Walau bagaimanapun, orang ramai kekal berhati-hati, dan perasaan itu berasas. Boleh difahami jika reformasi mengambil masa. Namun, banyak reformasi yang sekian lama dituntut oleh masyarakat sivil telah ditangguhkan, dilemahkan atau diketepikan. Undang-undang yang bersifat menindas, seperti Akta Hasutan dan Seksyen 233 Akta Komunikasi dan Multimedia, masih terus digunakan. Kadangkala ia digunakan oleh pihak-pihak yang suatu ketika dahulu pernah berkempen menentang undang-undang tersebut. Penahanan pemimpin Mandiri Layanan yang diterima baru-baru ini oleh kumpulan yang diterajui golongan muda, Mandiri, menunjukkan betapa jauh lagi perjalanan yang perlu ditempuhi. Menurut Mandiri, awal bulan ini [September], akaun bank mereka dibekukan dan larangan perjalanan dikenakan tanpa sebarang penjelasan kepada umum. Kemudian, pada 18 September, pihak polis menyerbu pejabat yang dikongsi oleh Mandiri dengan Hayat, sebuah kumpulan yang menentang hukuman mati. Seterusnya, pada 22 September, polis menahan pengarah eksekutif Mandiri, Amir Hariri Abdul Hadi, dan pengarah kewangannya, Dobby Chew, di bawah undang-undang pencegahan pengubahan wang haram. Walau apa pun kesudahannya, cara tindakan keras ini dilakukan menghantar mesej yang menggerunkan kepada sesiapa sahaja yang bersuara. Undang-undang yang bertujuan memerangi pengubahan wang haram tidak seharusnya digunakan untuk menakut-nakutkan masyarakat sivil. Perkara ini tidak boleh diterima di bawah kerajaan yang pernah berjanji untuk membuka ruang demokrasi. Pihak berkuasa mesti mendedahkan asas siasatan tersebut serta menarik balik pembekuan akaun dan larangan perjalanan yang dikenakan tanpa penjelasan. Mereka juga mesti menghentikan penggunaan kuasa pencegahan pengubahan wang haram terhadap kumpulan masyarakat sivil. Nampaknya, pertukaran pihak yang memerintah tidak menjamin perubahan dalam cara kuasa digunakan. Itulah sebabnya detik sekarang ini penting. Tekanan terhadap masyarakat sivil bukanlah satu isu terpencil. Ia merupakan sebahagian daripada kerja reformasi demokrasi yang belum selesai. Malah, kemajuan yang perlahan menjadikan peranan masyarakat sivil semakin penting, bukan sebaliknya. Setelah terlibat dengan Aliran selama hampir dua dekad, saya sendiri telah menyaksikan beberapa perubahan tersebut. title: 'Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi disokong peningkatan penerimaan risiko - Portal Berita RTM
body:
'

KUALA LUMPUR, 5 Oktober – Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi sedikit hari ini sejajar dengan prestasi positif di pasaran serantau susulan penerimaan risiko yang bertambah baik.

Peningkatan penerimaan risiko ini disokong oleh data lemah pasaran buruh Amerika Syarikat (AS) yang meredakan jangkaan Rizab Persekutuan AS mengetatkan dasarnya serta tekanan ke atas hasil bon.

Pada 5 petang, FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) meningkat 0.88 mata kepada 1,631.75 daripada paras penutup 1,630.87 pada Jumaat minggu lepas.

Indeks petunjuk pasaran yang dibuka tinggi naik 2.55 mata kepada 1,633.42, bergerak antara paras 1,630.95 dan 1,640.46 sepanjang sesi dagangan.

Bagaimanapun, di keseluruhan pasaran, kaunter rugi mengatasi kaunter untung sebanyak 599 berbanding 564, manakala 523 kaunter tidak berubah, 1,087 tidak diniagakan dan 24 digantung.

Jumlah dagangan meningkat kepada 4.78 bilion unit bernilai RM2.89 bilion daripada 4.23 bilion unit bernilai RM2.70 bilion pada Jumaat minggu lepas.

Naib presiden penyelidikan ekuiti Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd Thong Pak Leng berkata kaunter teknologi merupakan antara saham yang meraih keuntungan tinggi.

Di Wall Street semalaman, indeks S&P 500 meningkat 0.73 peratus kepada 7,722.72 dan Nasdaq Composite naik 1.19 peratus kepada 27,190.86.

Beliau berkata pasaran saham tempatan dijangka kekal positif dalam tempoh terdekat ini memandangkan FBM KLCI masih berada dalam kedudukan terlebih jual susulan penurunan ketara minggu lepas yang mana keadaan ini dijangka terus menarik minat pembelian pada harga rendah khususnya bagi saham mewah terpilih.

“Kecairan domestik juga terus menyokong, dengan institusi tempatan merekodkan pembelian bersih sebanyak RM352.4 juta pada minggu lepas, walaupun aktiviti penjualan berterusan oleh pelabur asing kekal menjadi faktor hambatan,” katanya kepada Bernama.

Justeru, Thong menjangkakan indeks petunjuk pasaran akan mencatatkan pemulihan secara beransur-ansur namun kekal tidak menentu, dengan FBM KLCI berkemungkinan diniagakan dalam jajaran 1,620-1,650 pada minggu ini.

Dalam kalangan saham wajaran tinggi, Public Bank meningkat lima sen kepada RM4.71, CIMB naik lapan sen kepada RM7.73, Tenaga Nasional menokok empat sen kepada RM13.00, Maybank susut dua sen kepada RM10.00, dan IHH Healthcare turun empat sen kepada RM7.76.

Dalam kalangan saham aktif, V.S Industry meningkat tiga sen kepada 32 sen, Zetrix AI susut lima sen kepada 6.5 sen, Jaks Resources turun sedikit sebanyak satu sen kepada 17 sen, Excel Force MSC merosot empat sen kepada 17 sen, manakala NationGate tidak berubah pada RM1.83.

Dalam kalangan kaunter paling untung, Malaysian Pacific Industries meningkat RM1.00 kepada RM43.40, UMS Integration melonjak 37 sen kepada RM9.40, Kelington naik 49 sen kepada RM9.12, Nestle menokok 48 sen kepada RM90.00, dan Samaiden menambah 35 sen kepada RM3.19.

Dalam kalangan saham paling rugi, Batu Kawan susut RM1.48 kepada RM18.98, United Plantations turun 32 sen kepada RM31.06, Hengyuan Refining Company berkurangan 18 sen kepada RM3.46 manakala Kuala Lumpur Kepong dan YTL Power International menyusut 14 sen masing-masing kepada RM20.86 dan RM5.54.

Di papan indeks, Indeks FBM Mid 70 meningkat 61.56 mata kepada 17,543.49, Indeks FBM Emas menambah 19.78 mata kepada 12,190.35, Indeks FBM Top 100 naik 15.70 mata kepada 11,973.38, Indeks FBM Emas Shariah menokok 8.69 mata kepada 12,069.01 dan Indeks FBM ACE melonjak 77.15 mata kepada 5,606.61.

Mengikut sektor, Indeks Produk dan Perkhidmatan Perindustrian naik sedikit sebanyak 0.45 mata kepada 178.97 dan Indeks Perkhidmatan Kewangan menambah 99.63 mata kepada 19,140.14, manakala Indeks Tenaga susut 3.09 mata kepada 829.94 dan Indeks Perladangan turun 125.52 mata kepada 8,931.03.

Jumlah dagangan Pasaran Utama meningkat kepada 3.13 bilion unit bernilai RM2.41 bilion daripada 2.67 bilion unit bernilai RM2.34 bilion pada Jumaat minggu lepas.

Jumlah dagangan waran naik kepada 1.04 bilion unit bernilai RM208.20 juta daripada 973.40 juta unit bernilai RM160.21 juta sebelumnya.

Jumlah dagangan Pasaran ACE menokok kepada 611.02 juta unit bernilai RM267.66 juta daripada 593.05 juta unit bernilai RM205.21 juta.

Sementara itu, kaunter produk dan perkhidmatan pengguna menyumbang sebanyak 248.10 juta saham di Pasaran Utama, diikuti produk dan perkhidmatan perindustrian (439.37 juta), pembinaan (183.56 juta), teknologi (1.76 bilion), perkhidmatan kewangan (49.02 juta), hartanah (106.95 juta), perladangan (22.08 juta), amanah pelaburan hartanah (10.76 juta), dana tertutup (152,900), tenaga (106.66 juta), penjagaan kesihatan (103.20 juta), telekomunikasi dan media (22.11 juta), pengangkutan dan logistik (40.92 juta), utiliti (38.48 juta), serta amanah perniagaan (162,200). -BERNAMA

title: 'Bursa Malaysia edges higher as risk appetite improves
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 5 — Bursa Malaysia closed slightly higher today, in line with upbeat regional markets, as improved risk appetite was supported by softer US labour data, that reduced expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening and eased pressure on bond yields. At 5pm, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) rose 0.88 of-a-point to 1,631.75 from last Friday’s close of 1,630.87. The benchmark index, which opened 2.55 points higher at 1,633.42, moved between 1,630.95 and 1,640.46 throughout the trading session. However, on the broader market, decliners surpassed gainers 599 to 564, while 523 counters were unchanged, 1,087 untraded and 24 suspended. Turnover improved to 4.78 billion units worth RM2.89 billion, compared with 4.23 billion units worth RM2.70 billion last Friday. Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd vice-president of equity research Thong Pak Leng said technology shares were among the main beneficiaries. On Wall Street overnight, the S&P 500 gained 0.73 per cent to 7,722.72 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.19 per cent to 27,190.86. For the local bourse, we remain slightly positive in the near term as the FBM KLCI remains in an oversold position following last week’s sharp correction, which should continue to attract bargain hunting, particularly in selected blue chips. “Domestic liquidity also remains supportive, with local institutions recorded RM352.4 million of net buying last week, although persistent foreign selling remains a headwind,” he told Bernama. Hence, Thong expects the benchmark index to stage a gradual recovery but remain volatile, with the FBM KLCI likely to trade within the 1,620-1,650 range this week. Among the heavyweights, Public Bank rose five sen to RM4.71, CIMB perked up eight sen to RM7.73, Tenaga Nasional climbed four sen to RM13.00, Maybank eased two sen to RM10.00, and IHH Healthcare slipped four sen to RM7.76. In active trade, V.S Industry rose three sen to 32 sen, Zetrix AI erased five sen to 6.5 sen, Jaks Resources inched down one sen to 17 sen, Excel Force MSC slid four sen to 17 sen, while NationGate was flat at RM1.83. Among the top gainers, Malaysian Pacific Industries increased RM1.00 to RM43.40, UMS Integration jumped 37 sen to RM9.40, Kelington garnered 49 sen to RM9.12, Nestle advanced 48 sen to RM90.00, and Samaiden surged 35 sen to RM3.19. Top losers were led by Batu Kawan, which decined RM1.48 to RM18.98; United Plantations fell 32 sen to RM31.06; Hengyuan Refining Company trimmed 18 sen to RM3.46, while Kuala Lumpur Kepong and YTL Power International shaved off 14 sen each to RM20.86 and RM5.54, respectively. On the index board, the FBM Mid 70 Index rose 61.56 points to 17,543.49, the FBM Emas Index added 19.78 points to 12,190.35, the FBM Top 100 Index went up 15.70 points to 11,973.38, the FBM Emas Shariah Index gained 8.69 points to 12,069.01, and the FBM ACE Index leapt 77.15 points to 5,606.61. Sector-wise, the Industrial Products and Services Index edged up 0.45 of a point to 178.97, the Financial Services Index garnered 99.63 points to 19,140.14, while the Energy Index shaved off 3.09 points to 829.94, and the Plantation Index tumbled 125.52 points to 8,931.03. The Main Market volume expanded to 3.13 billion units worth RM2.41 billion from 2.67 billion units worth RM2.34 billion last Friday. 'Bursa Malaysia edges higher as risk appetite improves

At 5pm, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) rose 0.88 of-a-point to 1,631.75 from last Friday’s close of 1,630.87. title: 'Permohonan Shamsul Iskandar untuk dapat pasport secara kekal diketahui 8 Disember
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR - Mahkamah Sesyen di sini menetapkan 8 Disember ini bagi memutuskan permohonan Datuk Seri Shamsul Iskandar Mohd. Akin untuk mendapatkan semula pasportnya secara kekal bagi memudahkan beliau menghadiri beberapa program di luar negara.  Hakim Suzana Hussin menetapkan tarikh itu selepas mendengar permohonan peguam Yusmadi Yusoff yang mewakili pemohon yang juga bekas Setiausaha Politik Kanan Perdana Menteri.  Pasport tersebut berada dalam simpanan mahkamah sebagai syarat jaminan tambahan selepas beliau didakwa atas lima pertuduhan rasuah.  Pada prosiding hari ini, Yusmadi memaklumkan bahawa permohonan bagi mendapatkan pasport secara kekal, difailkan pada 30 September lalu.  Menurut beliau, anak guamnya juga memohon pasport secara sementara bagi membolehkan beliau menghadiri program di Frankfurt dan London, bulan ini.  Bagaimanapun, Timbalan Pendakwa Raya Julaila Jamaludin membantah permohonan Shamsul Iskandar untuk mendapatkan pasportnya secara kekal atas alasan dokumen yang dikemukakan hanya berupa surat jemputan dan terdapat perbincangan yang boleh dijalankan secara dalam talian.  Bagaimanapun, Julaila tidak membantah permohonan Shamsul Iskandar untuk mendapatkan pasport secara sementara.  Suzana kemudian membenarkan pasport Shamsul Iskandar diberikan secara sementara mulai hari ini dan perlu diserahkan semula kepada mahkamah pada atau sebelum 16 Oktober ini.  Selain itu, mahkamah memerintahkan pihak pendakwaan memfailkan afidavit balasan terhadap permohonan Shamsul Iskandar bagi mendapatkan pasport secara kekal pada atau sebelum 19 Oktober ini.  Menerusi afidavit bagi menyokong permohonannya, Shamsul Iskandar berkata, beliau memerlukan pasportnya untuk perjalanan ke empat buah negara iaitu Frankfurt, London, Ireland dan Bosnia Herzegovina, dalam masa terdekat.  Berdasarkan dokumen yang diperoleh antara program yang dihadiri ialah pesta buku, sidang kemuncak dan lawatan kerja penglibatan perniagaan strategik.  Katanya, beliau berhasrat untuk ke Frankfurt, Jerman bagi menghadiri pesta buku bertajuk 'Frankfurt Book Fair' yang dianjurkan oleh Rex Education dan dijadualkan berlangsung 7 Oktober hingga 11 November.  "Berdasarkan penglibatan saya dengan Akademi Kepimpinan Masyarakat Madani, penyertaan dalam pesta buku tersebut bertujuan untuk memupuk sinergi antara organisasi serta memberikan manfaat bersama kepada kedua-dua entiti," katanya.  Sementara itu, bagi lawatan di London, Shamsul Iskandar memaklumkan beliau mendaftar untuk Sidang Kemuncak AlBaraka kelima bertajuk Ethics in Action: Rebuilding Foundations and Advancing the Global Impact of the Islamic Economy' yang akan berlangsung dari 13 Oktober hingga 14 Oktober ini.  Menurutnya, objektif utama sidang kemuncak tersebut adalah untuk memberi tumpuan kepada pengukuhan asas etika yang autentik bagi institusi kewangan Islam dan institusi bukan kewangan, sistem tadbir urus serta amalan pasaran.  Dalam pada itu, perjalanan ke Ireland dijadual bermula 27 November hingga 4 Disember ini bagi memenuhi jemputan Perbincangan Lanjutan Mengenai Strategi Perniagaan di negara itu.  Selain itu, beliau turut dijemput ke Bosnia Herzegovina pada November dan Disember ini untuk menghadiri beberapa siri perbincangan kedua-dua negara dalam pelbagai lapangan termasuk keusahawanan, pembangunan ekonomi dan transformasi sosial.  Justeru beliau memohon supaya pasport antarabangsanya dilepaskan secara kekal daripada tarikh perintah mahkamah bagi memudahkannya melakukan perjalanan ke luar negara.  Shamsul Iskandar, 51, didakwa atas dua pertuduhan bersetuju menerima suapan untuk dirinya, iaitu wang tunai RM140,000 daripada ahli perniagaan Tei Jiann Cheing atau turut dikenali sebagai Albert Tei sebagai dorongan membantu syarikat milik Albert Tei untuk mendapatkan kelulusan lesen penerokaan mineral di Sabah.  Dia turut didakwa atas dua lagi pertuduhan iaitu memperoleh untuk dirinya satu suapan berupa kelengkapan perabot dan barangan elektrik bernilai RM14,580.03 dan RM22,249 daripada individu sama bagi tujuan sama.  Kesalahan itu didakwa dilakukan di premis di Jalan Medang Serai, Bukit Bandaraya; di tempat letak kereta sebuah hotel di Jalan Sultan Hishamuddin di sini; serta di Jalan P14A 1/1, Presint 14, Putrajaya, antara 7 Disember 2023 dan 31 Januari 2024, serta antara 24 November 2023 dan 5 Mac 2024.  Shamsul Iskandar turut didakwa atas satu pertuduhan memperoleh suapan berjumlah RM64,924 yang dimasukkan ke dalam akaun CIMB Bank milik Rahmalidya Buyong bagi tujuan pembayaran penyewaan sebuah rumah di Jalan Medang Serai, Bukit Bandaraya, di sini, daripada Albert Tei bagi membantu syarikat miliknya mendapatkan kelulusan lesen penerokaan mineral di Sabah. - MalaysiaGazette
