title: 'Bursa Malaysia dibuka tinggi, jejaki peningkatan di Wall Street
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, 5 Oktober: Bursa Malaysia dibuka lebih tinggi pada Isnin, menjejaki kenaikan Wall Street berikutan pertumbuhan gaji Amerika Syarikat (AS) yang lebih perlahan, meredakan jangkaan kenaikan kadar faedah serta-merta oleh Rizab Persekutuan (Fed) AS. Pada 9.10 pagi, FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) meningkat 5.01 mata atau 0.31 peratus kepada 1,635.88 berbanding paras 1,630.87 ketika ditutup pada Jumaat. Indeks utama itu dibuka 2.55 mata lebih tinggi kepada 1,633.42. Sentimen pasaran secara keseluruhan positif dengan kaunter untung mengatasi kaunter rugi sebanyak 224 berbanding 158, sebanyak 337 kaunter tidak berubah, 2,054 tidak diniagakan dan 24 digantung dagangan. Jumlah dagangan berjumlah 206.30 juta saham bernilai RM98.78 juta. Naib Presiden Penyelidikan Ekuiti Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd, Thong Pak Leng berkata hasil bon 10 tahun AS kekal tinggi pada paras 5.28 peratus manakala harga minyak mentah Brent ditutup pada US$102.25 setong, menjadikan sentimen pasaran sensitif terhadap kadar faedah dan perkembangan di Asia Barat. “Di Hong Kong, Indeks Hang Seng susut di bawah paras 24,000 berikutan penyusutan saham sektor kewangan dan teknologi. “Di pasaran tempatan, susulan penutupan lebih tinggi FBM KLCI pada Jumaat lepas, kami menjangkakan kestabilan sementara dalam julat 1,625-1,635 hari ini, dengan aktiviti pembelian saham pada harga rendah memberikan sedikit sokongan di sebalik sentimen pasaran yang berhati-hati,” katanya kepada Bernama. Saham wajaran tinggi menyaksikan Maybank, Public Bank, CIMB dan Tenaga Nasional menambah empat sen masing-masing kepada RM10.06, RN4.70, RM7.69, dan RM13.00, manakala IHH Healthcare berkurangan enam sen kepada RM7.74. Bagi saham aktif, VS Industry menambah tiga sen kepada 32 sen, Notion VTec naik empat sen kepada 74.5 sen, GB Bond meningkat setengah sen kepada 23.5 sen, SFP Tech menokok satu sen kepada 28.5 sen, manakala Dagang NeXchange tidak berubah pada 51.5 sen. Antara saham paling untung, Samaiden naik 19 sen kepada RM3.03, UWC meningkat 16 sen kepada RM7.73, Critical Holdings menokok 15 sen kepada RM2.61, Mi Technovation melonjak sembilan sen kepada RM5.30, dan Solarvest mengukuh lapan sen kepada RM4.25. Nestle mendahului saham paling rugi, susut 32 sen to RM89.20, manakala Vitrox merosot 14 sen kepada RM10.32, Kobay Technology berkurangan 12 sen kepada RM2.18, Kelington menguncup lima sen kepada RM8.58, dan YTL Power International turun empat sen kepada RM5.64. Di papan indeks, Indeks FBM Mid 70 menambah 28.14 mata kepada 17,510.07, Indeks FBM Emas meningkat 33.81 mata kepada 12,204.38, Indeks FBM Top 100 naik 32.24 mata kepada 11,989.92, Indeks FBM Emas Syariah bertambah 22.28 mata kepada 12,082.60, manakala Indeks FBM ACE meningkat 31.41 mata kepada 5,560.87. Mengikut sektor, Indeks Produk dan Perkhidmatan Perindustrian naik 0.59 mata kepada 179.11, Indeks Tenaga naik 2.57 mata kepada 835.60, Indeks Perkhidmatan Kewangan meningkat 97.59 mata kepada 19,138.10, manakala Indeks Perladangan melonjak 2.23 mata kepada 9,058.78. – Bernama

title: 'PTT Synergy beli 4 kilang dalam pembinaan bernilai RM32 juta di Klang sebelum disewakan
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 5 Okt — PTT Synergy Group Berhad bakal memperluas portfolio hartanah dengan pemerolehan empat unit kilang bernilai hampir RM32 juta di Klang, Selangor, yang disasarkan menjana pendapatan sewa berulang daripada penyewa industri. Menerusi makluman tambahan kepada Bursa Malaysia, ia berkata anak syarikat tidak langsung milik penuhnya, PTT Assets Sdn Bhd, akan memperoleh empat bidang tanah bersama unit kilang yang sedang atau akan dibina dengan jumlah pertimbangan tunai RM31.997 juta. Menurut kumpulan tersebut, pemerolehan itu bertujuan mengembangkan portfolio pelaburan hartanah kumpulan dan mewujudkan aliran pendapatan sewa berulang menerusi penyewaan keempat-empat unit kilang kepada penyewa industri. "PTT merancang memulakan proses mencari penyewa serta rundingan pajakan sepanjang tempoh pembinaan, dengan operasi sewaan disasarkan bermula selepas projek siap dan milikan kosong diserahkan, tertakluk kepada kerja pengubahsuaian yang diperlukan," katanya. Keempat-empat hartanah dijangka disiapkan dalam tempoh 36 bulan daripada tarikh perjanjian jual beli (SPA) masing-masing, dengan kerja pembinaan telah bermula pada 7 Januari 2026 dan kini mencapai sehingga peringkat rangka struktur bangunan, atau kira-kira 55% siap. Dari segi pembiayaan, risiko pembelian itu disokong kelulusan pinjaman daripada CIMB Bank Berhad dengan margin pembiayaan 90%, selain rebat Bumiputera 10% yang diberikan penjual. Berdasarkan terma pembayaran, 10% daripada harga pembelian perlu dibayar sebaik sahaja setiap SPA ditandatangani, manakala baki bayaran dibuat secara berperingkat mengikut kemajuan pembinaan sehingga notis milikan kosong dikeluarkan. "Pembelian itu turut mengambil kira transaksi hartanah perindustrian berdekatan, termasuk sebuah kilang berkembar di Bukit Raja Prime Industrial Park seluas 1,854.99 meter persegi yang didagangkan pada RM8.5 juta pada Jun 2026," jelas PTT. Satu lagi perbandingan ialah kilang berkembar di Bukit Raja 3 Industrial Park berkeluasan 2,024.99 meter persegi yang direkodkan pada harga RM7.689 juta pada Mac 2026. title: 'Monday wrap: Young architects rise, insurers rethink adequacy, AI trust gaps widen
body: 'Architecture's young talent, a shift in insurance strategy, AI trust gaps, and rising bank margins mark the week.  Last week in Singapore Business Review, eight architects under 40 were named for their work on hospitals, civic infrastructure, and heritage projects. Etiqa Insurance said the industry's challenge is shifting from expanding coverage to ensuring adequacy as customers plan for retirement and wealth transfer. Nearly all IT leaders reported artificial intelligence (AI) tools accessing sensitive data without permission, whilst AI shopping adoption climbed even as checkout trust lagged. Banks, meanwhile, are expected to see margins rise as SORA climbs toward 1.4% by year-end.  Singapore Business Review's list of notable architecture professionals under 40 for 2026 features eight honourees—five women and three men—from DP Architects, SAA Architects, RSP Architects Planners & Engineers, CPG Consultants, and Chang Architects. Their combined portfolio spans a $790m hotel (the largest Mercure property worldwide), Singapore's first fully integrated healthcare campus at Woodlands Hospital, and civic landmarks including One Punggol's Regional Library and the Goh Keng Swee Centre for Education, a 30-storey office tower under active construction.  Standout work included Kelvin Ng Si Hoa's role delivering Woodlands Hospital despite expressway noise and rocky terrain constraints, and Loh Zhu Ping's contributions to the $450m Funan Redevelopment and the $790m Mercure ICON Singapore City Centre.  Singapore insurers should shift focus from expanding coverage to ensuring policy adequacy, according to Etiqa Insurance Singapore CEO Claudia Soh, as customers increasingly treat insurance as part of long-term financial planning rather than pure protection against loss. Singapore's insurance penetration stood at 7.6% of GDP as of May 2026, ranking fourth among selected Asian markets behind South Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong.  A May CIMB report found 52.6% of residents viewed insurance as supporting financial independence, up from 45% in 2025, with customers increasingly looking at retirement, wealth-building, and inheritance planning. Soh said AI can help insurers tailor services but cautioned that "trust, human judgement, and meaningful customer relationships remain just as important."  Nearly all Singaporean IT leaders (98.9%) reported an AI tool or agent accessing sensitive data beyond its intended scope in the past year, the second-highest rate among eight markets surveyed in Delinea's 2026 Identity Security Report.  Despite 99.6% of organisations having a formal AI data access policy, only 14% of IT leaders can detect a scope violation as it happens, and 72% take a full day or longer to catch one—the highest globally. Employee behaviour compounds the risk: 84% of Singaporean employees said they have bypassed required approval processes for AI use, and just 38% of IT leaders said they can always trace a sensitive access event back to a named human authoriser.  Singapore consumers are increasingly shopping with AI, but remain wary of letting it complete purchases, according to Adyen's 2026 Singapore Retail Report. Whilst 72% of consumers use AI assistants for shopping, only 29% are comfortable letting AI complete a purchase, and 49% of existing AI shopping users hesitate at the payment stage.  Still, AI-referred visitors generate 53% more revenue per visit and convert 54% more than non-AI traffic. Separately, Salesforce's State of Commerce report found 82% of Singapore commerce leaders expect large language models to become essential to product discovery within the year, with agentic search usage as a shopping-journey starting point up 200% year-over-year.  Singapore's three-month benchmark borrowing rate is expected to climb to 1.4% by year-end, supporting bank margins into 2027, according to UOB Kay Hian. The three-month compounded SORA rose to 1.22% in the third quarter after falling to 1.02% in April, reflecting MAS's tighter monetary policy stance amid slowing money supply growth.  UOB Kay Hian raised its 2027 net profit forecasts for DBS and OCBC by 5.7% and 4.7% respectively, citing expected margin gains, whilst flagging risks from elevated US rates and potential Red Sea shipping disruptions that could push freight and oil costs higher.

title: 'Kebijakan MDR QRIS 0% diperluas, bank hadapi tekanan fee dari bisnis acquiring
body: 'KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA. Perluasan Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) QRIS 0% mulai 1 Oktober 2026 berpotensi menekan pendapatan berbasis komisi bank dari bisnis QRIS dan acquiring.  Namun, pertumbuhan jumlah merchant dan transaksi QRIS dinilai masih dapat membuka peluang bagi bank untuk menjaga kinerja bisnis melalui peningkatan aktivitas transaksi dan pemanfaatan layanan lainnya.  Seperti diketahui, Bank Indonesia (BI) memperluas MDR QRIS 0% untuk merchant Usaha Mikro (UMI) dengan transaksi hingga Rp500.000. Selain itu, MDR 0% juga berlaku bagi seluruh kategori merchant untuk transaksi hingga Rp100.000.  Gubernur BI Destry Damayanti mengatakan, kebijakan tersebut dirancang dengan prinsip keseimbangan, yakni memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat dan ruang tumbuh bagi merchant sekaligus menciptakan peluang baru bagi penyelenggara jasa sistem pembayaran dengan tetap menjaga keberlanjutan industri.  Perluasan tersebut dilakukan ketika adopsi QRIS masih menunjukkan pertumbuhan kuat. Hingga Juni 2026, jumlah pengguna QRIS mencapai 65,77 juta pengguna, dengan 6,23 juta di antaranya merupakan pengguna baru sepanjang Januari-Juni 2026.  Jumlah merchant QRIS juga telah mencapai 44,86 juta, dengan 96,68% di antaranya merupakan UMKM. Sementara sepanjang semester I 2026, QRIS mencatat 12,55 miliar transaksi dengan nilai Rp1,12 kuadriliun, tumbuh 93,92% secara tahunan.  Kepala Pusat Makroekonomi dan Keuangan Institute for Development of Economics and Finance (Indef), M Rizal Taufikurahman menilai, perluasan MDR 0% secara langsung akan mengurangi komisi bank dari transaksi yang sebelumnya dikenakan MDR.  Menurut Rizal, biaya pemrosesan dan keamanan transaksi tetap berjalan meski tarif MDR bagi merchant menjadi 0%. Karena itu, bank dengan porsi transaksi berbayar yang besar akan lebih terdampak.  “Perluasan MDR QRIS 0% mengurangi komisi bank pada transaksi yang sebelumnya berbayar, sementara biaya pemrosesan dan keamanan tetap berjalan,” kata Rizal kepada kontan.co.id, Minggu (4/10/2026).  Ia menilai, ekspansi QRIS tetap perlu menghasilkan pendapatan yang mampu menutup biaya layanan. Sebab, lonjakan volume transaksi saja belum otomatis memperkuat profitabilitas bank.  Menurutnya, kompensasi atas potensi penurunan fee harus berasal dari peningkatan nilai transaksi yang masih dikenakan MDR maupun pertumbuhan komisi dari layanan lainnya.  Sebagai ilustrasi, kehilangan 20% pendapatan MDR membutuhkan kenaikan sekitar 25% nilai transaksi berbayar yang tersisa. Sementara kehilangan 30% pendapatan MDR membutuhkan kenaikan sekitar 43%, dengan asumsi komisi efektif tetap.  Rizal juga mengingatkan, transaksi dengan tarif 0% dapat meningkatkan aktivitas QRIS tanpa memberikan tambahan MDR kepada bank. Adapun dana murah yang berasal dari aktivitas merchant memang dapat membantu margin bunga, tetapi tidak dapat dianggap sebagai pemulihan pendapatan komisi.  Di sisi lain, ia melihat adopsi QRIS masih kuat. Hingga Agustus 2026, merchant QRIS BSI telah melampaui 604.000, tumbuh 17% secara tahunan, dengan nilai transaksi mencapai Rp5,7 triliun. Secara nasional, volume transaksi QRIS pada Agustus 2026 tumbuh 67,22%.  Namun, menurut Rizal, pertumbuhan penggunaan QRIS tersebut belum otomatis menunjukkan penguatan pendapatan non-bunga bank. Kemampuan menghasilkan pendapatan tetap bergantung pada jumlah merchant aktif, nilai transaksi berbayar, serta komisi efektif bank.  Untuk sisa 2026, Rizal memperkirakan jumlah merchant dan transaksi QRIS masih akan bertambah. Penurunan biaya penerimaan pembayaran dan momentum belanja akhir tahun menjadi salah satu pendorong.  Meski begitu, pertumbuhan transaksi QRIS dapat pula berasal dari peralihan pembayaran tunai ke digital tanpa disertai peningkatan belanja masyarakat. Alhasil, pertumbuhan komisi bank berpotensi tertinggal dibandingkan pertumbuhan transaksi.  “Keuntungan bank akan ditentukan oleh kemampuannya mempertahankan saldo merchant, memperluas penggunaan layanan berbayar, dan menekan biaya per transaksi,” ujarnya.  Di sisi lain,  Direktur Center of Economic and Law Studies (Celios), Bhima Yudhistira Adhinegara melihat dampak perluasan MDR QRIS 0% terhadap komisi bank masih berpotensi dikompensasi oleh pertumbuhan pendapatan dari layanan lainnya.  Menurut Bhima, semakin luas penetrasi pembayaran melalui QRIS dapat mendorong pertumbuhan fee based income dari produk asuransi dan investasi. Aktivitas merchant yang meningkat juga dapat memperbesar volume simpanan serta layanan cash management, termasuk payroll.  Dari sisi kredit, semakin banyak merchant yang menggunakan QRIS juga membuka peluang bagi bank untuk menghubungkan merchant dengan layanan pembiayaan, seperti factoring, kredit modal kerja, maupun jenis kredit lainnya.  Bhima menilai. kebijakan MDR 0% dapat membuat masyarakat dan merchant semakin nyaman menggunakan QRIS karena tidak ada pungutan yang dibebankan kepada merchant untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan tersebut.  Ia juga memperkirakan, transaksi QRIS masih akan terus meningkat seiring dengan semakin luasnya penetrasi QRIS, termasuk pengembangan konektivitas pembayaran QRIS di kawasan ASEAN.  Sementara, SEVP Digital Business BTN Thomas Wahyudi mengatakan, perluasan MDR QRIS 0% memang berdampak terhadap pendapatan berbasis komisi, terutama untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan MDR 0%.  Namun, BTN tidak melihat QRIS semata-mata sebagai sumber fee based income. Perseroan juga menjadikan QRIS sebagai bagian dari pengembangan ekosistem transaksi digital secara keseluruhan.  “Perluasan MDR QRIS 0% tentunya memberikan dampak terhadap pendapatan berbasis komisi, khususnya untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan tersebut. Namun, bagi BTN, QRIS tidak hanya dilihat dari sisi fee based income, tetapi juga sebagai bagian dari pengembangan ekosistem transaksi digital secara keseluruhan,” kata Thomas.  Menurutnya, pertumbuhan jumlah merchant dan volume transaksi menjadi salah satu faktor yang dapat membantu menjaga kinerja bisnis QRIS setelah MDR 0% berlaku.  Penerapan MDR 0% pada segmen transaksi tertentu dinilai dapat mendorong merchant semakin memanfaatkan QRIS sebagai sarana pembayaran utama, baik dari sisi jumlah transaksi maupun nilai transaksi.  Meski demikian, Thomas menilai, kenaikan volume transaksi pada tahap awal lebih berperan menjaga kinerja bisnis QRIS secara keseluruhan, bukan menjadi pengganti langsung potensi penurunan pendapatan berbasis komisi.  Besarnya dampak terhadap pendapatan akan bergantung pada jumlah merchant, frekuensi transaksi, dan nilai transaksi ke depan. Karena itu, BTN akan terus memantau perkembangan tersebut dan menyesuaikan strategi bisnis acquiring melalui pengembangan layanan dan solusi yang dapat meningkatkan aktivitas serta nilai transaksi merchant.  Hingga September 2026, transaksi QRIS BTN telah meningkat sekitar 157% secara tahunan. Sementara volume transaksi tumbuh 166% YoY.  Pertumbuhan tersebut didorong oleh bertambahnya jumlah merchant, meningkatnya adopsi QRIS oleh nasabah BTN, serta berbagai program aktivasi transaksi yang dijalankan perseroan.  BTN juga melihat penerapan MDR 0% dapat memberikan sentimen positif dari sisi merchant karena biaya transaksi menjadi lebih ringan untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan.  Hingga akhir 2026, BTN menargetkan jumlah merchant mencapai 480.000 merchant. Untuk mengejar target tersebut, BTN tidak hanya berfokus pada akuisisi merchant baru, tetapi juga meningkatkan kontribusi transaksi dari merchant yang sudah masuk dalam ekosistem perseroan.  BTN akan melakukan segmentasi pengembangan merchant. Akuisisi tetap dilakukan untuk memperluas ekosistem, sementara merchant non-UMI dengan volume dan nilai transaksi tinggi akan menjadi salah satu fokus pengembangan untuk menjaga pertumbuhan volume transaksi dan kinerja acquiring.  BTN juga mendorong aktivitas merchant melalui program Balé 3S (Santai, Santap, Sehat) dan Bale Connect the World.  “Pertumbuhan QRIS BTN diharapkan tidak hanya berasal dari peningkatan jumlah merchant, tetapi juga dari peningkatan frekuensi dan nilai transaksi,” ujar Thomas.  Adapun, Head of Digital Banking and Contact Center CIMB Niaga Lusiana Saleh mengakui perluasan MDR QRIS 0% akan mengurangi porsi fee perseroan dari transaksi yang masuk dalam kebijakan tersebut.  Meski demikian, CIMB Niaga menilai kebijakan tersebut tetap tepat karena dapat mendorong penggunaan transaksi nontunai dan menggerakkan aktivitas ekonomi.  “Sebenarnya menurut kami, kami agak shock sedikit, karena porsi kami berkurang sebenarnya. Tapi menurut kami, ini adalah gerakan yang cukup tepat karena kami mendukung untuk siklus ekonomi, roda harus berjalan,” kata Lusiana.  Menurut Lusiana, transaksi bernilai kecil seperti pembelian kopi yang berada di kisaran Rp40.000-Rp50.000 menjadi salah satu contoh transaksi yang dapat semakin didorong dengan kebijakan MDR 0%.  Ia menilai perluasan MDR 0% dapat membantu memperluas penggunaan transaksi cashless, termasuk di kalangan UMKM.  CIMB Niaga mencatat transaksi QRIS melalui aplikasi OCTO tumbuh sekitar 65% YoY pada semester I 2026. QRIS juga menjadi kanal transaksi digital dengan penggunaan tertinggi di CIMB Niaga, disusul transaksi transfer melalui BI-FAST.  Meski fee berpotensi berkurang, CIMB Niaga tidak terlalu mengkhawatirkan dampak kebijakan tersebut terhadap bisnis QRIS. Lusiana mengatakan QRIS memiliki fungsi strategis untuk meningkatkan loyalitas nasabah sekaligus mendorong aktivitas transaksi melalui OCTO.  “QRIS itu sebenarnya salah satu fitur utama yang kita pakai untuk menggaet loyalitas nasabah untuk melakukan transaksi,” ujarnya.  Menurut Lusiana, penggunaan QRIS juga lebih murah dan praktis dibandingkan transaksi menggunakan kartu maupun uang tunai. Dari sisi operasional, nasabah cukup menggunakan OCTO tanpa membutuhkan kartu fisik.

Meski begitu, pertumbuhan transaksi QRIS dapat pula berasal dari peralihan pembayaran tunai ke digital tanpa disertai peningkatan belanja masyarakat. Alhasil, pertumbuhan komisi bank berpotensi tertinggal dibandingkan pertumbuhan transaksi.  “Keuntungan bank akan ditentukan oleh kemampuannya mempertahankan saldo merchant, memperluas penggunaan layanan berbayar, dan menekan biaya per transaksi,” ujarnya.  Di sisi lain,  Direktur Center of Economic and Law Studies (Celios), Bhima Yudhistira Adhinegara melihat dampak perluasan MDR QRIS 0% terhadap komisi bank masih berpotensi dikompensasi oleh pertumbuhan pendapatan dari layanan lainnya.  Menurut Bhima, semakin luas penetrasi pembayaran melalui QRIS dapat mendorong pertumbuhan fee based income dari produk asuransi dan investasi. Aktivitas merchant yang meningkat juga dapat memperbesar volume simpanan serta layanan cash management, termasuk payroll.  Dari sisi kredit, semakin banyak merchant yang menggunakan QRIS juga membuka peluang bagi bank untuk menghubungkan merchant dengan layanan pembiayaan, seperti factoring, kredit modal kerja, maupun jenis kredit lainnya.  Bhima menilai. kebijakan MDR 0% dapat membuat masyarakat dan merchant semakin nyaman menggunakan QRIS karena tidak ada pungutan yang dibebankan kepada merchant untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan tersebut.  Ia juga memperkirakan, transaksi QRIS masih akan terus meningkat seiring dengan semakin luasnya penetrasi QRIS, termasuk pengembangan konektivitas pembayaran QRIS di kawasan ASEAN.  Sementara, SEVP Digital Business BTN Thomas Wahyudi mengatakan, perluasan MDR QRIS 0% memang berdampak terhadap pendapatan berbasis komisi, terutama untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan MDR 0%.  Namun, BTN tidak melihat QRIS semata-mata sebagai sumber fee based income. Perseroan juga menjadikan QRIS sebagai bagian dari pengembangan ekosistem transaksi digital secara keseluruhan.  “Perluasan MDR QRIS 0% tentunya memberikan dampak terhadap pendapatan berbasis komisi, khususnya untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan tersebut. Namun, bagi BTN, QRIS tidak hanya dilihat dari sisi fee based income, tetapi juga sebagai bagian dari pengembangan ekosistem transaksi digital secara keseluruhan,” kata Thomas.  Menurutnya, pertumbuhan jumlah merchant dan volume transaksi menjadi salah satu faktor yang dapat membantu menjaga kinerja bisnis QRIS setelah MDR 0% berlaku.  Penerapan MDR 0% pada segmen transaksi tertentu dinilai dapat mendorong merchant semakin memanfaatkan QRIS sebagai sarana pembayaran utama, baik dari sisi jumlah transaksi maupun nilai transaksi.  Meski demikian, Thomas menilai, kenaikan volume transaksi pada tahap awal lebih berperan menjaga kinerja bisnis QRIS secara keseluruhan, bukan menjadi pengganti langsung potensi penurunan pendapatan berbasis komisi.  Besarnya dampak terhadap pendapatan akan bergantung pada jumlah merchant, frekuensi transaksi, dan nilai transaksi ke depan. Karena itu, BTN akan terus memantau perkembangan tersebut dan menyesuaikan strategi bisnis acquiring melalui pengembangan layanan dan solusi yang dapat meningkatkan aktivitas serta nilai transaksi merchant.  Hingga September 2026, transaksi QRIS BTN telah meningkat sekitar 157% secara tahunan. Sementara volume transaksi tumbuh 166% YoY.  Pertumbuhan tersebut didorong oleh bertambahnya jumlah merchant, meningkatnya adopsi QRIS oleh nasabah BTN, serta berbagai program aktivasi transaksi yang dijalankan perseroan.  BTN juga melihat penerapan MDR 0% dapat memberikan sentimen positif dari sisi merchant karena biaya transaksi menjadi lebih ringan untuk transaksi yang masuk dalam ketentuan.  Hingga akhir 2026, BTN menargetkan jumlah merchant mencapai 480.000 merchant. Untuk mengejar target tersebut, BTN tidak hanya berfokus pada akuisisi merchant baru, tetapi juga meningkatkan kontribusi transaksi dari merchant yang sudah masuk dalam ekosistem perseroan.  BTN akan melakukan segmentasi pengembangan merchant. Akuisisi tetap dilakukan untuk memperluas ekosistem, sementara merchant non-UMI dengan volume dan nilai transaksi tinggi akan menjadi salah satu fokus pengembangan untuk menjaga pertumbuhan volume transaksi dan kinerja acquiring.  BTN juga mendorong aktivitas merchant melalui program Balé 3S (Santai, Santap, Sehat) dan Bale Connect the World.  “Pertumbuhan QRIS BTN diharapkan tidak hanya berasal dari peningkatan jumlah merchant, tetapi juga dari peningkatan frekuensi dan nilai transaksi,” ujar Thomas.  Adapun, Head of Digital Banking and Contact Center CIMB Niaga Lusiana Saleh mengakui perluasan MDR QRIS 0% akan mengurangi porsi fee perseroan dari transaksi yang masuk dalam kebijakan tersebut.  Meski demikian, CIMB Niaga menilai kebijakan tersebut tetap tepat karena dapat mendorong penggunaan transaksi nontunai dan menggerakkan aktivitas ekonomi.  “Sebenarnya menurut kami, kami agak shock sedikit, karena porsi kami berkurang sebenarnya. Tapi menurut kami, ini adalah gerakan yang cukup tepat karena kami mendukung untuk siklus ekonomi, roda harus berjalan,” kata Lusiana.  Menurut Lusiana, transaksi bernilai kecil seperti pembelian kopi yang berada di kisaran Rp40.000-Rp50.000 menjadi salah satu contoh transaksi yang dapat semakin didorong dengan kebijakan MDR 0%.  Ia menilai perluasan MDR 0% dapat membantu memperluas penggunaan transaksi cashless, termasuk di kalangan UMKM.  CIMB Niaga mencatat transaksi QRIS melalui aplikasi OCTO tumbuh sekitar 65% YoY pada semester I 2026. QRIS juga menjadi kanal transaksi digital dengan penggunaan tertinggi di CIMB Niaga, disusul transaksi transfer melalui BI-FAST.  Meski fee berpotensi berkurang, CIMB Niaga tidak terlalu mengkhawatirkan dampak kebijakan tersebut terhadap bisnis QRIS. Lusiana mengatakan QRIS memiliki fungsi strategis untuk meningkatkan loyalitas nasabah sekaligus mendorong aktivitas transaksi melalui OCTO.  “QRIS itu sebenarnya salah satu fitur utama yang kita pakai untuk menggaet loyalitas nasabah untuk melakukan transaksi,” ujarnya.  Menurut Lusiana, penggunaan QRIS juga lebih murah dan praktis dibandingkan transaksi menggunakan kartu maupun uang tunai. Dari sisi operasional, nasabah cukup menggunakan OCTO tanpa membutuhkan kartu fisik.

title: 'Existing taxes key to 2027 Budget, expect few major changes: Expert
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia is likely to focus on improving tax collection and fine-tuning existing taxes rather than introducing major new levies in 2027 Budget, according to KPMG senior tax policy adviser Dr Veerinderjeet Singh. He said stronger enforcement, better use of tax agency analytics and broader tax bases could provide additional revenue while supporting the government's fiscal consolidation efforts. Speaking at a forum hosted by CIMB Securities, Veerinderjeet said the government should "sweat our assets". This is by improving collection efficiency, with scope to gradually raise Malaysia's tax-to-gross domestic product ratio towards 15 per cent through stronger personal, corporate and indirect tax bases. He expects few major tax changes in the upcoming budget, given the continued focus on cost-of-living support and social spending. Recent measures such as the dividend and capital gains taxes reflect a more progressive tax system, although he does not expect the two per cent dividend tax to be raised or capital gains tax extended to listed shares in the budget. A further increase in the 30 per cent top personal income tax rate also appears unlikely. On the sales and service tax (SST), Veerinderjeet estimates coverage has reached about 78-80 per cent of goods and services, bringing it closer to the breadth of the former goods and services tax (GST). He sees scope for broader input exemptions under SST to reduce cascading effects and business costs, although this would mean some revenue loss. GST reinstatement is not expected in thr 2027 Budget, with improving SST efficiency likely to take precedence. Wider e-invoicing participation could also help uncover unreported taxable activity, although exemptions for smaller businesses may be gradually reduced as economic conditions improve. On other measures, Veerinderjeet expects limited additional revenue from the global minimum tax until the first filing cycle provides clearer evidence of collections. A carbon tax remains on the policy agenda but could be delayed to 2028 or later amid business cost pressures. The budget may reaffirm the government's intention to introduce it, potentially at a low initial rate. He also sees only a slight possibility of modest excise duty increases on alcohol and tobacco, while no new windfall levy is expected. For real estate investment trusts, he does not expect the former 10 per cent final withholding tax on distributions to return, although he supports withholding mechanisms to reduce filing and monitoring costs.

title: 'Warga Palestin diculik: Waran tangkap terhadap tertuduh ketujuh
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR – Mahkamah Tinggi di sini pada Jumaat mengeluarkan waran tangkap terhadap seorang daripada lapan tertuduh dalam kes penculikan seorang lelaki warga Palestin pada 2022. Hakim, Datuk Mohd Arief Emran Arifin mengeluarkan perintah itu terhadap Muhammad Iqmal Abdul Rahis, 31, selepas tertuduh tidak hadir pada prosiding kes berkenaan. Ketika pengurusan kes, penjamin tertuduh memaklumkan bahawa, usaha menjejaki Muhammad Iqmal termasuk pergi ke rumahnya di kawasan ladang kelapa sawit telah dilakukan sebelum ini. “Saya pergi ke kampungnya di Tanjung Sepat, tetapi adik-beradik dia kata tidak jumpa,” katanya. Sementara itu, Timbalan Pendakwa Raya, Zaileen Nadia Zubir berkata, pihak pendakwaan juga sudah berusaha mengesan tertuduh ketujuh itu sejak 11 September lalu. Menurutnya, pihak berkuasa turut pergi ke Tanjung Sepat, Banting, Kuala Langan dan bertanyakan mengenai keberadaan tertuduh kepada bapanya. “Bapa tertuduh memberitahu lelaki berkenaan tidak balik kampung sejak Januari lalu dan pihak berkuasa masih berusaha mengesan tertuduh,” katanya. Susulan itu, Hakim, Mohd Arief Emran mengeluarkan waran tangkap terhadap Muhammad Iqmal. Mahkamah turut memerintahkan wang jaminan sebanyak RM50,000 dikembalikan kepada penjamin selepas mengambil kira usaha yang dilakukan bagi mengesan tertuduh. Dalam prosiding itu, Muhammad Iqmal diwakili peguam, Goh Cia Yee. Sebelum ini, mahkamah menetapkan perbicaraan kes berkenaan ditetapkan pada 12 hingga 15, 19 hingga 23 dan 26 hingga 29 October. Pada Oktober 2022, seramai 13 lelaki dan seorang wanita didakwa di Mahkamah Majistret di sini atas pertuduhan menculik warga Palestin, Omar Z M Albelbaisy Raeda, 35, bagi mendapatkan ganjaran berupa rahsia maklumat berkaitan perisian menggodam telefon bimbit. Mereka ialah Edy Ko’im Said, 46, Mohamad Norakmal Hassan, 47, Dody Junaidi, 48, Tengku Arif Bongsu Tengku Hamid, 45, Mohamad Naziree Mustapha, 45, Faizull Hardey Mohd Isa, 46, Muhammad Iqmal, Mohamad Sufian Saly, 29, Muhammad Al Hatim Mohd Fauzi, 29, Nidarahayu Zainal, 40, Raibafie Amdan, 45, Mohd Zaidi Mohd Zain, 60, Mohd Azwan Jamaludin 55, dan Tengku Hazarul Ismail Tengku Hamid, 55. Kesalahan itu didakwa dilakukan di Jalan Mayang, di sini, pada jam 10.40 malam 28 September 2022. Pertuduhan dibuat mengikut Seksyen 3 Akta Penculikan 1961 dibaca bersama Seksyen 34 Kanun Keseksaan yang memperuntukkan hukuman penjara antara 30 hingga 40 tahun serta sebatan, jika sabit kesalahan. Pada 20 Oktober 2023, Tengku Arif Bongsu bersama pasangan suami isteri, Nidarahayu dan Raibafie turut didakwa atas 19 pertuduhan pengubahan wang haram berjumlah lebih RM250,000. Bagi pertuduhan pertama hingga keempat, Nidarahayu didakwa melupuskan wang RM20,650.86 hasil aktiviti haram daripada akaun simpanannya di CIMB Bank ke dua akaun bank lain di CIMB Bank dan Maybank Islamic Berhad di Cawangan Taman Maluri, antara 15 September hingga 3 Oktober 2022. Dia turut berdepan 13 pertuduhan memindahkan wang RM184,985.46 ke dalam akaun empat syarikat dan lapan individu, juga hasil aktiviti haram, antara 15 September hingga 2 Oktober tahun sama. Raibafie dan Tengku Arif Bongsu masing-masing didakwa menerima RM30,350 dan RM25,000 daripada dua akaun bank milik Nidarahayu serta sebuah syarikat, di CIMB Bank Cawangan Jalan Bukit Bintang dan Taman Mutiara, Cheras antara 29 September hingga 2 Oktober 2022. Pertuduhan dibuat mengikut Seksyen 4(1)(b) Akta Pencegahan Pengubahan Wang Haram, Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasan dan Hasil daripada Aktiviti Haram 2001 yang membawa hukuman penjara maksimum 15 tahun dan denda lima kali ganda nilai aktiviti haram atau RM5 juta, yang mana lebih tinggi, jika sabit kesalahan. Pada 10 Julai 2025, enam lelaki dihukum penjara lima tahun oleh Mahkamah Tinggi di sini selepas mengaku bersalah atas pertuduhan pilihan melarikan dan mengurung seorang lelaki Palestin itu. Hakim, K Muniandy yang kini hakim Mahkamah Rayuan di Putrajaya, menjatuhkan hukuman itu terhadap Mohamad Norakmal, Mohd Azwan, Dody, Mohamad Sufian, Tengku Hazarul Ismail dan Muhammad Al Hatim. Mengikut pertuduhan, mereka didakwa melarikan mangsa secara paksa terhadap lelaki Palestine sama dengan dikurung secara salah dan rahsia di Jalan Mayang, Dang Wangi di sini pada jam 10.40 malam, 28 September 2022. Kesemua tertuduh didakwa mengikut Seksyen 365 Kanun Keseksaan dan dibaca bersama Seksyen 34 akta sama yang membawa hukuman penjara sehingga tujuh tahun dan boleh dikenakan denda. Mengikut fakta kes, mangsa dilarikan dan dikurung di sebuah chalet di Hulu Langat. Serbuan polis yang dilakukan berdasarkan maklumat berjaya menyelamatkan mangsa yang ketika itu berada dalam keadaan tangan dan kaki diikat dengan pengikat kabel.

title: 'HLIB Retail Research – Tradersbrief 30 Sep
body: 'Asian markets traded mostly lower as elevated bond yields and oil prices kept risk appetite cautious, while China’s equities edged higher on expectations of stronger policy support and the RBA raised its cash rate by 25bps to 4.60%, a 15-year high, as inflation remained above target. Meanwhile, Brent crude climbed to ~USD106/bbl amid continued US-Iran tensions and uncertainty over Strait of Hormuz traffic. US Treasury yields remained elevated, with the 10Y near 5.26%, keeping markets focused on upcoming US inflation and labour data this week for clues on Fed policy. Wall Street pared intraday losses to end modestly lower (Dow -0.26%, S&P 500 -0.16%, Nasdaq -0.09%) as Treasury yields and oil prices eased from intraday highs. The US 10Y yield briefly hit 5.30%, its highest since 2007, before ending flat at 5.24%, while the 30Y topped 5.62% before easing to 5.56% after John Williams said the Fed need not rush its next move. Softer data offered some relief, with Aug job openings falling to 7.08m (Jul: 7.33m) and consumer confidence to 81.9 (Aug: 88.9), ahead of the key PCE and NF payrolls data. AI trade remained resilient, supported by reports that Anthropic is targeting a >US2trn valuation for its planned Nov IPO, while Brent fell 2.5% to ~US102/bbl on SPR releases, recovering Saudi exports and indirect US-Iran talks via mediators. Malaysia. Mirroring the sluggish Wall Street and regional markets, primarily driven by global risk-off sentiment amid surging oil prices, elevated US Treasury yields and persistent foreign outflows, the KLCI skidded 26 pts (1.56%) to 1,64, with losers (22) thumping gainers (4) among KLCI components, led by selldown in CIMB, MAYBANK, PBBANK, RHBBAN, PCHEM and TENAGA. Foreign institutions extended net outflows for a 5th straight day (-RM172m; 5D: -RM786m; MTD: -RM1.46bn; YTD: -RM5.92bn) followed by local institutions (-RM6m; 5D: +RM356m; MTD: -RM33m; YTD: +RM4.87bn). In contrast, local retailers (+RM178m; 5D: +RM430m; MTD: +RM1.49bn; YTD: +RM1.05n) emerged as key net buyers. The KLCI plunged 26 pts or 1.56% on 29 Sep, breaching its previous YTD low of 1,655 (29 June) and closing at 1,644 to mark a fresh YTD low. The breakdown reinforces the bearish technical setup, with the index trading firmly below its key MAs and long-term rising trendline, while momentum indicators remain bearish. Although a near-term technical rebound cannot be ruled out after the 6.2% or 109-pt slide from 1,753 (4M high), upside is likely to face stiff resistance at 1,655, 1,680 (23.6% FR) and 1,704 (MA200). A sustained break below 1,655 would reinforce the downtrend and expose the next key supports at 1,624 (38.2% FR) and 1,600. With the US-Iran impasse and hawkish Fed vibes persisting, the KLCI could extend its risk-off consolidation amid elevated oil prices, bond yields and persistent foreign outflows. Domestically, expectations of moderating GDP growth in 2027 to 4.7% (2026: 5.3%), potential corporate earnings disappointments and household affordability concerns amid higher-for-longer costs and global supply-chain disruptions could weigh on sentiment. title: 'HLIB Retail Research – Tradersbrief 23 Sep
body: 'Global. Asian markets ended mixed as investors weighed easing oil prices and bond yields against lingering geopolitical risks. Sentiment remained cautious ahead of the 23–25 Sep Trump-Xi meeting, with markets hoping for an extension of the US-China trade truce while watching developments on AI, export controls and rare-earth supplies. Meanwhile, Iran indicated it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if Washington eased military pressure, while Saudi Arabia reportedly restarted its East-West Pipeline, raising hopes of improving oil supply. Wall Street (Dow -0.36%, S&P 500 0.0%, Nasdaq 0.45%) ended mixed as continued AI strength offset weakness in financials, while easing oil prices and geopolitical tensions supported sentiment. AI infrastructure stocks remained in demand, fuelled by strong reception for Meta’s Muse AI agent. Meanwhile, Anthropic’s new lower-cost AI model added to optimism over broader AI adoption, with its reported IPO targeted for November. Geopolitical risks remained in focus as Trump said the US and Iran could reach a deal after the November midterm elections, while Tehran indicated it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if Washington eased military pressure. Malaysia. Tracking Wall Street gains, bargain-hunting in selected heavyweights and oversold readings, the KLCI jumped 16.6 pts to 1,683.5, led by IHH, CIMB, SUNWAY, HLBANK, PBBANK and MAYBANK. Market breadth improved to 1.48 from 1.18, while trading activity rose 5% to 3.58bn shares worth RM3.15bn. Foreign institutions (+RM20m; 5D: +RM75m; MTD: -RM674m; YTD: -RM5.13bn) and local retailers (+RM20m; 5D: +RM205m; MTD: +RM1.06bn; YTD: +RM0.62bn) were net buyers, while local institutions remained net sellers (-RM40m; 5D: -RM280m; MTD: -RM389m; YTD: +RM4.51bn). After a 95-pt surge from its YTD low of 1,655 on 29 Jun to 1,753 on 26 Aug, the KLCI corrected to 1,661.9 (21 Sep) before rebounding to 1,683.5 on 22 Sep, with momentum indicators turning up. However, the index remains below the LT ascending line and within the descending channel, keeping the near-term bias bearish, with major supports pegged at 1,655 (YTD low) and 1,639 (23.6% FR). On the upside, reclaiming 1,685 (50% FR) and 1,701 (MA200) would strengthen signs of stabilisation, targeting 1,717 (MA50) and 1,731 (76.4% FR). A decisive breakout above these levels would negate the bearish setup and refocus attention on 1,753 and 1,771 (YTD high). With expectations of a constructive Trump-Xi summit, easing oil prices and oversold technical readings, the KLCI could extend its rebound towards 1,700. However, the index remains entrenched in a downtrend channel, while tricky domestic backdrops—including potential 2H earnings disappointments amid a higher-for-longer cost environment, the dissolution of the Melaka state assembly today for the 16th state election, and lingering GE16 speculation—could cap gains and keep volatility elevated ahead of Budget 2027 on 9 Oct. title: 'Malaysia-Myanmar: The repatriation question
body: 'A group of 1,476 people have been returned to Myanmar from Malaysia earlier this week, as part of a wider repatriation programme that could eventually involve up to 5,000 people. The government says the returns are voluntary, however the UN refugee agency has questioned whether people held in immigration detention can make a genuinely free and informed decision to return to a country still under ongoing conflict. Astro Awani’s Melisa Idris talks to with Sharifah Shakirah, the founder and director of the Rohingya Women Development Network, and Dr Moe Thuzar, a senior fellow and co-ordinator of the the Myanmar studies programme at Iseas-Yusof Ishak Institute in Singapore. title: 'Bursa dibuka rendah pada pagi ini
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR,. Bursa Malaysia dibuka rendah pada Khamis, menjejaki prestasi bercampur-campur Wall Street berikutan hasil bon Perbendaharaan AS yang lebih tinggi serta ketegangan berterusan di Asia Barat menjejaskan minat belian. Pada 9.10 pagi, FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) susut 3.74 mata atau 0.22 peratus kepada 1,647.43 daripada paras 1,651.17 ketika ditutup pada Rabu. Indeks penanda aras itu dibuka 1.30 mata lebih rendah pada 1,649.87. Di pasaran meluas, kaunter rugi mengatasi kaunter untung sebanyak 200 berbanding 142, manakala 307 kaunter tidak berubah, 2,124 kaunter tidak diniagakan dan 12 kaunter digantung. Jumlah dagangan sebanyak 246.59 juta saham bernilai RM118.14 juta. Mengikut sektor, Indeks Produk dan Perkhidmatan Perindustrian susut 0.10 mata kepada 180.31, manakala Indeks Tenaga meningkat 1.41 mata kepada 847.11. Indeks Perkhidmatan Kewangan turun 27.47 mata kepada 19,189.02, manakala Indeks Perladangan merosot 33.34 mata kepada 9,163.33. — BERNAMA

title: 'Bursa Malaysia Opens Lower On Higher US Yields, West Asia Tensions
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 1 – Bursa Malaysia opened lower on Thursday morning, tracking a mixed overnight performance on Wall Street as rising US Treasury yields and persistent geopolitical tensions in West Asia dampened investor appetite. At 9:10 AM, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) fell 3.74 points, or 0.22 per cent, to 1,647.43 compared to Wednesday’s closing level of 1,651.17. The key index opened 1.30 points lower at 1,649.87. Market breadth across the broader market was negative, with decliners outpacing gainers 200 to 142, while 307 counters traded unchanged, 2,124 untraded, and 12 suspended. Early turnover reached 246.59 million shares valued at RM118.14 million. Heavyweights and Active Counters Financial and utility heavyweights dragged on the benchmark index during early trade: - Public Bank fell 3 sen to RM4.67. - Tenaga Nasional lost 2 sen to RM12.94. - CIMB shed 1 sen to RM7.78. - Maybank and IHH Healthcare traded flat at RM9.90 and RM7.83, respectively. In active trading, ACE Market debutant GB Bond fell half a sen to 24.5 sen, while VS Industry traded unchanged at 28 sen. Divfex gained 2 sen to 11 sen, Jaks Resources rose 1 sen to 21.5 sen, and Astro Malaysia added half a sen to 6 sen. Energy and consumer-linked stocks featured among the top gainers: - Keck Seng advanced 11 sen to RM5.14. - Petron Malaysia picked up 7 sen to RM3.47. - Hengyuan Refining and Spritzer each rose 6 sen to RM3.62 and RM3.67, respectively. - Jati Tinggi gained 5 sen to RM1.44. Plantation and technology counters led early losses: - Kuala Lumpur Kepong dropped 18 sen to RM22.02. - UWC shed 15 sen to RM6.92. - Insights Analytics and MISC each declined 9 sen to RM1.20 and RM7.55, respectively. - Petronas Dagangan lost 8 sen to RM19.20. Index and Sectoral Trends Sectoral performance was mostly lower, with financial and plantation stocks leading the decline while energy counters bucked the trend: - The Plantation Index retreated 33.34 points to 9,163.33. - The Financial Services Index dropped 27.47 points to 19,189.02. - The Industrial Products and Services Index slipped 0.10 of a point to 180.31. - The Energy Index rose 1.41 points to 847.11. Across broader index boards: - The FBM Mid 70 Index dropped 42.26 points to 17,532.41. - The FBM Emas Index fell 26.32 points to 12,265.69. - The FBM Top 100 Index lost 27.82 points to 12,056.62. - The FBM Emas Shariah Index weakened 22.09 points to 12,154.26. - The FBM ACE Index trimmed 6.31 points to 5,527.97. –NMT

title: 'Bursa Malaysia Closes Lower Amid Cautious Wall Street Influence
body: 'Kuala Lumpur:Bursa Malaysia ended the trading session lower on Thursday due to persistent selling pressure, influenced by a mixed and cautious performance on Wall Street overnight. According to BERNAMA News Agency, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) dropped 20.81 points, or 1.26 percent, closing at 1,630.36, down from the previous day's close of 1,651.17. The index opened slightly weaker at 1,649.87 and fluctuated between 1,630.10 and 1,649.87 throughout the day. The market trend showed a negative breadth, with 750 decliners outpacing 342 gainers, while 495 counters remained unchanged, 1,186 were untraded, and 12 were suspended. Turnover decreased to 3.1 billion units valued at RM2.7 billion, compared to 3.63 billion units worth RM3.62 billion on Wednesday. Mohd Sedek Jantan, the director of investment strategy and country economist at IPPFA Sdn Bhd, noted that the sentiment was cautious, exacerbated by weaker domestic manufacturing activity and continued foreign selling. He highlighted that softer manufacturing momentum and global portfolio rotation exerted pressure on the benchmark index, despite domestic institutional demand providing some balance against foreign outflows. The S and P Global Malaysia Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) slightly dipped below the neutral 50.0 mark, reaching 49.9 in September from 50.2 in August. This marks the first decline in four months following a period of improvement. Regionally, the S and P Global ASEAN Manufacturing PMI decreased to 52.1 in September from 52.3 in August. In terms of specific stocks, Maybank fell four sen to RM9.95, Public Bank lost three sen to RM4.67, and CIMB dropped 10 sen to RM7.69. Tenaga Nasional declined six sen to RM12.90, while IHH Healthcare erased 13 sen to RM7.70. Among active trades, Zetrix AI firmed half a sen to 16.5 sen, VS Industry dipped one sen to 27 sen, and Jaks Resources slipped 2.5 sen to 18 sen. ACE Market debutant GB Bond slumped 4.5 sen to 20.5 sen, with HHRG gaining half a sen to 16.5 sen. Top gainers included Malaysian Pacific Industries, which surged 72 sen to RM41.12, Ayer Holdings rising 20 sen to RM7.70, and Riverview Rubber Estates advancing 12 sen to RM3.02. Dutch Lady Malaysia Industries added 10 sen to RM30, while Vitrox gained nine sen to RM10. Among the biggest losers, Kuala Lumpur Kepong dropped 78 sen to RM21.42, Allianz Malaysia gave up 62 sen to RM21.00, and United Plantations fell 60 sen to RM30.96. Fraser and Neave, along with Hong Leong Industries, both slipped 32 sen to RM21.42 and RM16.14, respectively.

title: 'Life Water Poised for Further Growth as Capacity and Distribution Expand
body: 'Life Water Berhad (“Life Water”, Bursa: LWSABAH, 5328) is positioned for continued growth, backed by spare production capacity, an expanding distribution network in Sabah and rising demand for its bottled water and carbonated drinks. The Sabah-based beverage maker reported a 19.9% increase in revenue to RM207.31 million for the financial year ended 30 June 2026, while net profit grew 23.8% to RM37.15 million. Momentum strengthened towards the year-end, with fourth-quarter revenue up 28% year on year to RM57.01 million and net profit up 21% to RM10.95 million. The growth was driven by higher drinking water sales volumes, a price revision implemented in May 2026, seasonally stronger demand during hot weather and wider distribution. Gross margin reached 49.3% in the second quarter, supported by better operational efficiency and lower raw material costs. Life Water is the leading bottled water and carbonated drinks brand in Sabah and held about 11% of Malaysia’s bottled water market at the time of its Main Market listing in November 2024. Since then, its share price has risen from the IPO price of RM0.65 to around RM1.66, giving it a market capitalisation of about RM785 million. A key factor behind the group’s growth outlook is its available capacity. Following new production lines funded by its IPO, including the expansion of the Sandakan Sibuga Plant 1 completed in June 2025, annual drinking water capacity stands at about 626 million litres, with utilisation of around 60%. This allows the group to meet higher demand without major new investment. The group is also investing in reaching more customers. Its truck fleet has grown from 70 to 90 units, and new distribution centres are being established in Tawau, Lahad Datu and Keningau, extending coverage to Sabah’s east coast and interior. In December 2025, Life Water began supplying Sabah’s largest mini-market chain, which operates about 280 outlets. Its products are also included in the government’s Sumbangan Asas Rahmah (SARA) programme. External conditions are supportive. Visit Malaysia Year 2026 is drawing more visitors to Sabah, lifting demand from hotels, food service outlets and retailers, while bottled water demand during the dry season typically runs about 30% above normal. Beyond Sabah, the group has been building its presence in Sarawak and Brunei through local distributors. CIMB Securities has a Buy call on Life Water with a target price of RM2.05, and forecasts core net profit to grow at a compound annual rate of 22.9% from FY2025 to FY2028.

title: 'BernamaBiz - Malaysia Entering More Supportive Water Investment Cycle  -- CIMB Securities
body: 'Malaysia Entering More Supportive Water Investment Cycle -- CIMB Securities KUALA LUMPUR, Sept 28 (Bernama) -- Malaysia is entering a more supportive water investment cycle as ageing infrastructure, high water losses and rising industrial and data centre demand, as well as greater climate variability are increasing the urgency to improve water efficiency, reliability, and resilience. In a note today, CIMB Securities said the federal government had approved RM1.7 billion under the 13th Malaysia Plan to replace about 1,800 kilometres of critical pipes from 2026 to 2030, alongside a multi-year National Non-Revenue Water (NRW) Programme. It said sizeable projects including Langat 2 Phase 2, Rasau Phase 2, and the Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme should further strengthen water security and provide a visible pipeline for contractors, pipe manufacturers and ancillary solution providers. CIMB Securities said Malaysia’s NRW rate stood at 37.1 per cent in 2024. “Persistently high NRW, ageing distribution networks, and rising climate variability result in unnecessary raw water extraction, higher treatment and pumping requirements, weaker utility economics, and supply disruption risks. “Concurrently, population growth, industrialisation, and rapid data centre development are driving structural water demand, particularly across economic corridors in Selangor, Johor, and Penang,” it added. The stockbroking company said Malaysia’s water transition is seen broadening from purely building new infrastructure towards using existing water resources and assets more efficiently. It said sustainable NRW reduction requires physical rehabilitation alongside smart metering, leak detection, pressure management, telemetry, analytics, and intelligent asset-management systems. “These technologies can make water networks more visible, measurable, and manageable, improving the effectiveness of every ringgit spent on water infrastructure. “This is aligned with the Water Sector Transformation 2040 (WST2040), which promotes digitalisation, climate resilience, integrated water-resource management, and stronger sector governance,” it said. From an investment perspective, CIMB Securities said it favours companies positioned at either the efficiency or infrastructure-enablement layers of Malaysia’s water transition. “Insight Analytics Bhd is among the most direct listed proxies to water digitalisation and NRW management, while Gamuda Bhd offers exposure to large-scale treatment, transmission, and water security projects. “The key near-term risk remains the pace at which funding and policy commitments translate into tenders, project awards, and, ultimately, earnings,” it said. -- BERNAMA

title: 'Indonesia land reform raises uncertainty for Malaysian planters with exposure there — CIMB Securities
body:
'

KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 25): Malaysian plantation companies with sizeable operations in Indonesia face greater regulatory uncertainty following the country’s new agrarian reform law, with SD Guthrie Bhd (KL:SDG), Genting Plantations Bhd (KL:GENP) and Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd (KL:KLK) among those with the largest exposure, according to CIMB Securities.

The potential impact, however, remains unclear as key details — including maximum landholding limits for companies and affiliated entities, and how a provision requiring at least 20% of certain land to be made available for agrarian reform and redistribution — have yet to be finalised through implementing regulations.

As such, CIMB has not made any adjustments to its earnings forecasts or the land banks of plantation companies under its coverage, saying it sees higher regulatory uncertainty rather than an immediate loss of land or earnings.

“We do not expect an across-the-board 20% cut in existing land,” the research house said in a note on Friday.

Indonesia’s parliament approved the Agrarian Reform Law on Tuesday, creating a broader framework to address land ownership concentration, redistribution and longstanding agrarian conflicts. The law also provides for a dedicated body under the president to oversee implementation, supervision and conflict resolution.

However, the Indonesian government still needs to draw up implementing rules that will, among other matters, determine minimum and maximum landholding limits. Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning Minister Nusron Wahid said such details would be provided through subsequent regulations.

The development was reported earlier this week, including by Bloomberg, which highlighted broader risks to Indonesia’s plantation and property sectors. CIMB’s latest assessment focuses on the potential implications for Malaysian-listed plantation companies.

Among CIMB’s Malaysian plantation coverage, SD Guthrie, Genting Plantations and KLK have the largest absolute plantation exposure to Indonesia. IOI Corp Bhd (KL:IOICORP) has a smaller relative exposure, while Johor Plantations Group Bhd (KL:JPG), Ta Ann Holdings Bhd (KL:TAANN) and Hap Seng Plantations Holdings Bhd (KL:HSPLANT) have plantation operations entirely in Malaysia.

Separately, India’s decision to lower import duties on major edible oils could provide some support for crude palm oil (CPO) demand, although CIMB expects the benefit to Malaysian planters to be modest.

title: 'TNB Could Absorb Up to RM150 Million in Extra Costs From Expanded Electricity Relief, CIMB Securities Says
body: 'TNB Could Absorb Up to RM150 Million in Extra Costs From Expanded Electricity Relief, CIMB Securities Says KUALA LUMPUR — Tenaga Nasional Bhd could absorb an additional RM120 million to RM150 million in costs between September and December 2026 following the expansion of government exemptions covering electricity-related charges for residential consumers, according to CIMB Securities. The brokerage said nearly one million additional households are expected to benefit after the monthly electricity consumption threshold for the exemptions was raised to 800 kilowatt-hours (kWh) from 600 kWh. The change brings the total number of residential consumers covered to more than eight million. The exemptions involve the Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA), retail charges and sales and service tax, reducing the immediate impact of electricity costs on a wider group of households. However, CIMB Securities said the arrangement means TNB is expected to absorb additional costs during the September-to-December protection period. The eventual financial impact will depend on the level of AFA charges during that period, which in turn is influenced by fuel costs. Unexpected cost for utility CIMB Securities described the development as a negative surprise because it had previously expected TNB to recover any government-sanctioned AFA subsidies through the Kumpulan Wang Industri Elektrik fund. The latest arrangement instead places an estimated RM120 million to RM150 million of additional costs on the national utility during the final four months of 2026. The research house noted that TNB had previously made a voluntary RM150 million corporate contribution towards the government’s tiered electricity rebate initiative between April and September 2020. That programme was introduced during the Covid-19 pandemic. CIMB Securities said it regarded the 2020 contribution differently because it was made in response to what it described as a severe and unprecedented crisis. The latest cost absorption therefore raises a broader question for investors over whether TNB could be required to shoulder similar costs beyond 2026. 2026 profit forecast trimmed Despite the additional burden, CIMB Securities maintained its “buy” recommendation on TNB and kept its discounted cash flow-based target price unchanged at RM15.90. The brokerage reduced its core net profit forecast for TNB’s full 2026 financial year by two per cent to account for the additional costs. Its core net profit forecasts for the 2027 and 2028 financial years were left largely unchanged. CIMB Securities said the immediate effect on TNB’s core earnings remained relatively small and was insufficient to change its valuation. Its longer-term concern centres instead on what could happen if fuel prices remain elevated and the expanded AFA exemptions continue beyond the end of 2026. Regulatory predictability in focus The research house warned that requiring TNB to absorb further subsidies could affect investor perceptions of the predictability of the utility’s regulated returns. TNB operates under Malaysia’s Incentive Based Regulation framework, which is intended to provide a structured mechanism governing electricity tariffs, costs and regulated returns. For investors, the issue therefore extends beyond the RM120 million to RM150 million estimated impact this year. CIMB Securities said continued cost absorption beyond 2026 could raise concerns about how consistently costs and returns would be treated under the regulatory framework. For households, meanwhile, the higher 800 kWh threshold extends protection from the specified electricity charges to almost one million more residential users. The balance between shielding consumers from higher electricity costs and maintaining the financial predictability of the regulated utility could consequently remain an important issue if fuel costs stay elevated into 2027.

title: 'Budget 2027 Preview: CIMB Sees More CASH Aid, Tax Relief, Higher Minimum Wage
body: 'Malaysians could see higher cash assistance, targeted personal income tax relief and a possible increase in the minimum wage under Budget 2027, as the government seeks to cushion living costs while maintaining its fiscal consolidation programme, according to CIMB Treasury and Markets Research.  In its Budget 2027 preview, Doing More Within Limits, the research house forecasts the fiscal deficit narrowing to 3.4% of gross domestic product (GDP) in 2027 from an estimated 3.5% this year, supported by lower fuel subsidy expenditure and stronger government revenue.  The budget, scheduled to be tabled on Oct 9, is expected to balance household assistance with development spending and measures to strengthen productivity, investment and the domestic economy.  CIMB expects the government to avoid a broad fiscal stimulus package, instead directing available resources towards targeted support and initiatives that could deliver longer-term economic benefits.  The Ministry of Finance’s Pre-Budget Statement has identified cost-of-living pressures, social protection, productivity, infrastructure and governance among the priorities for Budget 2027, although specific allocations and tax changes have yet to be announced  STR And SARA Could Rise To RM17 Billion  One of CIMB’s principal expectations is an increase in combined Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) and Sumbangan Asas Rahmah (SARA) allocations to RM17 billion from RM15 billion in 2026.  The additional RM2 billion would help maintain household purchasing power amid higher living costs, particularly for lower-income groups.  CIMB expects the increase to remain focused on the RM100 SARA payment for Malaysians aged 18 and above, alongside targeted STR payments determined by income and household characteristics.  However, the research house cautioned that household spending would increasingly depend on employment and private-sector wage growth as the impact of earlier civil service salary increases moderates.  Despite the proposed increase in assistance, CIMB expects total subsidies and social assistance expenditure to decline to RM73 billion in 2027 from RM79.1 billion in 2026, principally because of lower projected fuel subsidies.  Middle-Income Taxpayers May Receive Relief  CIMB also sees scope for targeted personal income tax relief aimed at middle-income Malaysians who face rising household expenses but may receive less direct cash assistance.  Its illustrative proposal involves reducing selected personal income tax rates by one percentage point and adjusting the tax bracket above RM100,000 in chargeable income.  Under this scenario, taxpayers with RM70,000 in chargeable income could save approximately RM200 annually, while those with RM100,000 could save RM500.  The maximum saving would reach RM1,000 annually for taxpayers with chargeable income of RM150,000 and above.  CIMB estimates that a package of this scale would cost the government approximately RM800 million annually.  These are possible adjustments examined by the research house, rather than confirmed Budget 2027 measures.  Businesses could also receive further Sales and Service Tax (SST) relief, particularly on production inputs and services where taxes are embedded at multiple stages of the supply chain.  CIMB expects selected exemptions to be expanded or extended, potentially benefiting manufacturing, construction and agriculture.  It has factored approximately RM1 billion in additional SST relief into its projections while forecasting overall SST revenue to increase to RM72 billion in 2027.  A broader mechanism allowing businesses to claim credits for tax paid on eligible inputs could be considered, although CIMB believes such a system would be more likely from 2028 onwards because of the administrative requirements involved.  Minimum Wage Could Increase To RM1,800–RM2,000  Another development that workers and employers will be watching is a possible revision to the statutory minimum wage.  CIMB sees scope for the current RM1,700 minimum wage to rise to between RM1,800 and RM2,000, with RM1,800 to RM1,900 considered more consistent with a gradual adjustment.  The research house noted that businesses are already contending with higher labour, energy and logistics costs, while productivity improvements have not necessarily kept pace with wage increases.  Against this backdrop, CIMB believes a broad implementation of the multi-tier foreign worker levy may be less likely in the near term, as employers require more time to absorb existing cost pressures and invest in automation.  Lower Fuel Subsidies Key To Fiscal Consolidation  CIMB’s projections depend significantly on an easing of fuel subsidy expenditure.  The research house expects petrol and diesel subsidies to decline to RM32 billion in 2027 from RM41 billion in 2026, assuming Brent crude averages US$85 a barrel and the ringgit averages RM4.10 against the US dollar.  The RM9 billion reduction would create additional fiscal room for household assistance and development programmes without reversing the government’s deficit reduction trajectory.  However, CIMB warned that prolonged disruptions to global energy supplies could keep oil prices elevated and undermine the expected savings.  In such a scenario, the government could face pressure to retain selected operating expenditure controls or tighten subsidised fuel quotas and eligibility requirements.  Higher fuel costs without sufficient offsetting savings would place additional pressure on the fiscal deficit.  Development Spending To Rise To RM83 Billion  Beyond household support, CIMB forecasts gross development expenditure increasing to RM83 billion in 2027 from RM80 billion this year.  It expects spending priorities to include infrastructure, energy and food security, productivity improvements and investment incentives that generate stronger domestic economic benefits.  The research house said the next phase of investment policy is likely to focus more closely on realised projects, local supply-chain participation, technology transfer and the creation of higher-quality jobs.  On the revenue side, CIMB projects federal government revenue rising 3.7% to RM373 billion, supported partly by a higher PETRONAS dividend of RM25 billion, compared with RM20 billion budgeted for 2026.  It also expects approximately RM1 billion in receipts from the global minimum tax.  Further details on Malaysia’s planned carbon tax could emerge in Budget 2027, although CIMB does not expect meaningful revenue from the measure next year.  Economic Growth Seen At 4.5% In 2027  CIMB forecasts Malaysia’s economic growth moderating to 4.5% in 2027 from 5.0% in 2026, with headline inflation easing slightly to 1.8% from 1.9%.  The research house expects Budget 2027 to provide modest support for domestic demand rather than generate a major acceleration in economic activity.  It also forecasts gross Malaysian Government Securities and Government Investment Issues issuance easing to RM181 billion in 2027 from RM185 billion, reflecting lower debt maturities.  Ultimately, CIMB expects Budget 2027 to centre on a fiscal balancing exercise: providing additional relief to households and businesses while preserving resources for development and gradually reducing the deficit.  The extent to which those objectives can be achieved will depend heavily on energy prices, government revenue performance and the ability to contain expenditure without disrupting essential services or investment.

title: 'Budget 2027 may bring SST exemptions, income tax relief for middle-income earners — CIMB Securities
body:
'

KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 18): Budget 2027 could see further sales and service tax (SST) exemptions to reduce costs embedded in businesses, alongside possible personal income tax relief for middle-income taxpayers, according to CIMB Securities.

CIMB Securities said there is scope for the government to broaden SST exemptions for production-related inputs, as businesses continue to face elevated energy, logistics and other operating costs.

It expects further SST relief to reduce government collections by about RM1 billion, although underlying growth should still lift SST revenue by 5.5% to RM72 billion in 2027.

Unlike the goods and services tax (GST), the SST does not have a general input tax credit mechanism, meaning businesses may pay tax on inputs without being able to deduct it against tax charged on their own sales. This can result in tax costs being embedded through the supply chain, CIMB noted.

CIMB said in a note extending selected exemptions is likely to be the more immediate option in Budget 2027, while a broader input tax credit mechanism could be introduced from 2028 or later because of the additional administrative and refund framework required.

At the same time, CIMB sees room for targeted personal income tax relief for middle-income taxpayers, particularly households facing higher living costs but receiving less direct cash assistance.

As an illustration, the research house said tax rates for chargeable income of RM50,001 to RM70,000 and RM70,001 to RM100,000 could each be reduced by one percentage point to 10% and 18% respectively.

The current 25% tax bracket could also be split, with a 24% rate applied to chargeable income between RM100,001 and RM150,000.

Such a package could provide annual tax savings of RM200 for those with RM70,000 in chargeable income, RM500 at RM100,000 and as much as RM1,000 for those earning RM150,000 and above, CIMB estimated.

It said the illustrative package would cost the government about RM800 million annually.

More broadly, CIMB expects Budget 2027 to continue providing household support while maintaining fiscal consolidation, forecasting the fiscal deficit to narrow slightly to 3.4% of gross domestic product in 2027 from an estimated 3.5% in 2026.

The research house also expects cash assistance under Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah and Sumbangan Asas Rahmah to increase by RM2 billion to RM17 billion, supported partly by lower fuel subsidy spending.

CIMB forecasts petrol and diesel subsidies to fall to RM32 billion in 2027 from RM41 billion, creating room for higher household assistance and development spending while keeping the government on its fiscal consolidation path.

Budget 2027, the fifth Madani Budget and the second under the 13th Malaysia Plan, is scheduled to be tabled in Parliament on Oct 9. The Ministry of Finance has said the budget will focus on areas including cost-of-living pressures, business competitiveness and productivity, while maintaining fiscal discipline.

title: 'U Mobile catat kerugian lebih besar akibat kos 5G - CIMB Securities | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 17 Sept — Penyedia rangkaian 5G kedua Malaysia, U Mobile Sdn Bhd terus mengukuhkan kedudukan dalam perkhidmatan mudah alih apabila bahagian hasil pasaran syarikat meningkat kepada 17.4% pada tahun kewangan 2025 (FY25), menurut CIMB Securities. Bahagian hasil mudah alih U Mobile meningkat 0.8 mata peratusan kepada 17.4%, meneruskan trend peningkatan daripada hanya 2.1% pada FY2012. Hasil perkhidmatan mudah alih juga meningkat 5% tahun ke tahun (YoY) pada FY2025. Prestasi itu mengatasi CelcomDigi Berhad yang mencatat penurunan hasil mudah alih 1%, manakala hasil Maxis Berhad tidak berubah dalam tempoh sama. Pertumbuhan U Mobile berkemungkinan disokong peluasan rangkaiannya di Sabah dan Sarawak, termasuk pelaburan dalam pengedaran dan liputan rangkaian. "Jualan barangan U Mobile turut meningkat 41% YoY selepas mencatat pertumbuhan 38% pada FY2024, menunjukkan permintaan lebih kukuh terhadap pelan pascabayar dan jalur lebar 5G yang digabungkan dengan peranti," kata CIMB Securities. Bagaimanapun, prestasi kewangan U Mobile terjejas oleh kos rangkaian yang lebih tinggi serta susut nilai dipercepatkan berkaitan peluasan rangkaian jalur lebarnya. Kerugian bersih syarikat meningkat 124% YoY kepada RM1.62 bilion pada FY25, dengan susut nilai dipercepatkan meningkat kepada RM1.03 bilion berbanding RM489 juta pada FY24. CIMB Securities berkata kerugian bersih teras (CNL) U Mobile meningkat 163% YoY kepada RM595 juta. Jika kos faedah daripada pendahuluan pemegang saham (SHA) dan saham keutamaan boleh tebus dan tukar (RCPS) tidak diambil kira, CNL syarikat berjumlah RM383 juta berbanding RM19 juta setahun sebelumnya. Pendapatan sebelum faedah, cukai, susut nilai dan pelunasan (EBITDA) pula susut 38% YoY kepada RM773 juta, manakala margin EBITDA turun 15.2 mata peratusan kepada 22.2%, kemungkinan disebabkan kos rangkaian dan peranti yang lebih tinggi serta caj sekali sahaja. Sementara itu, susut nilai dan pelunasan (D&A) yang dinormalkan turun 10% YoY kepada RM935 juta, mencerminkan asas aset tetap yang lebih rendah selepas susut nilai dipercepatkan terkumpul sebanyak RM1.5 bilion pada FY2024 dan FY2025. Kos faedah bersih meningkat 2% YoY kepada RM432 juta. Dalam masa sama, perbelanjaan modal (capex) yang dijana nilai, tidak termasuk spektrum, melonjak lebih enam kali ganda kepada RM1.23 bilion pada FY2025 berikutan pelaksanaan rangkaian 5G bermula pertengahan 2025. Peningkatan perbelanjaan itu dibiayai menerusi pinjaman berjangka yang meningkat RM338 juta YoY, pembiayaan vendor sebanyak RM493 juta serta kredit perdagangan jangka pendek. Tidak termasuk SHA dan RCPS, hutang bersih U Mobile meningkat 25% YoY kepada RM3.38 bilion, manakala nisbah hutang bersih kepada EBITDA meningkat kepada 4.4 kali berbanding 2.3 kali bagi CelcomDigi dan 1.9 kali bagi Maxis. Aliran tunai bebas kepada ekuiti turut berubah kepada negatif RM251 juta daripada positif RM123 juta sebelumnya selepas mengambil kira capex aliran tunai RM819 juta dan pembayaran balik bersih pembiayaan vendor RM103 juta. Struktur pemegang saham U Mobile juga berubah apabila Mawar Setia Sdn Bhd menjadi pemegang saham terbesar dengan pegangan 50.2% pada 17 Mac, manakala pegangan Singapore Technologies Telemedia (ST Telemedia) susut kepada 20.7%.

title: 'CIMB Scheduled Downtime for Debit Card Users
body: '14th September 2026 - 2 min read You won’t be able to pay with your CIMB debit card for a few hours on 19, 22, and 23 September 2026. CIMB will be doing scheduled maintenance on its debit card system during the early morning on each of these days. The break covers debit cards from both CIMB Bank and CIMB Islamic. CIMB shared the dates in a notice to cardholders on 9 September 2026. All three maintenance breaks start at midnight. The first break starts when Friday night (18 September) turns into Saturday. The next two start straight after Monday night and Tuesday night. The longest break is on Tuesday, 22 September, when your card won’t work until 7.30am. If you usually pay for breakfast or your morning commute with your debit card, you’ll need another way to pay that morning. During these hours, you can’t make any purchases with your CIMB debit card. This includes tapping or inserting your card at a payment terminal in a shop, and entering your card details to pay on a website or app. It applies whether your card uses MyDebit, Visa, or Mastercard. So if you tap your card at a convenience store after midnight or pay for a late night food order with a saved card, the payment will fail. The card will work as usual again once each break ends. Paying through FPX, where you log in to your online banking to pay a website, doesn’t use your debit card. Neither do DuitNow transfers or scanning a DuitNow QR code with your banking app. CIMB’s notice only lists debit card purchases, so FPX and DuitNow payments aren’t included in this maintenance. If you need to buy something during these hours, pay for it earlier in the evening, or use FPX or DuitNow QR if the shop or website accepts them. If you’re unsure whether a specific payment will be affected, you can check with CIMB directly before the maintenance dates. For more information, you can read CIMB’s full notice [PDF]. title: '马股闭市微升1.60点  顶级手套飙11.46% - 财经 - 即时财经
body: '马股闭市微升1.60点 顶级手套飙11.46% （吉隆坡6日讯）中东石油出口增加，促使国际油价回落，带动区域股市普遍上涨，马股周二盘中曾升至1641.20点，上升9.45点，可惜午盘之后回吐部分涨幅，最终只升1.60点，以1633.35点挂收。 反映大盘走势的富时全股指数上扬42.52点，至12232.87点，创业板指数也起52.31点，至5658.92点。  其他马股各大指数普遍上涨，当中科技和医疗保健指数涨势凌厉，全日猛涨超过3%，金融服务、产业和交通物流指数下跌介于0.08%至0.38%。 全场股项涨多跌少，有667只上升股，超过456只下跌股，另有551只平盘。全场有41亿7664万1900股，总值29亿4950万1489令吉。 综指成分股方面，上升、下跌和平盘各报14只、14只和2只。 上涨的综指股包括国油化学（PCHEM,5183,主板工业产品服务组）起17仙，至4令吉30仙；IHH医保（IHH,5225,主板医疗保健组)涨15仙，收于7令吉91仙；森牙直利（SDG,5285,主板种植组)升10仙，至6令吉12仙。 银行股表现逊色，大众银行（PBBANK,1295,主板金融服务组)下跌4仙，收报4令吉67仙；马来亚银行（MAYBANK,1155,主板金融服务组)和联昌集团（CIMB,1023,主板金融服务组)各降3仙，分别跌至9令吉97仙和7令吉70仙。 顶级手套（TOPGLOV,7113,主板医疗保健组)第四季业绩亮眼，加上派发每股1.5仙终期股息，驱动股价午盘走势越战越勇，收盘上扬9仙或11.46%，至87.5仙，并以1亿6513万3800股的成交量，位居热门榜亚军。 近期跌跌不休的ZETRIX公司(ZETRIX,0138,主板科技组) 周二止跌回扬，闭市上涨2.5仙或38.46%，至9仙，成交量高达9亿6279万零400股，冲上热门榜榜首。 国际油价回落，以及美国科技股走稳，带动全球股市普遍上涨。 美国隔夜股市3大指数全面收高，收盘时，道琼斯工商指数起0.18%，标普500指数升0.66%，纳斯达克综指涨至历史新高，收盘上扬1.05%。 亚太股市大部分走高，印尼雅加达综指上涨1.21%，日本日经指数起1.05%，香港恒生指数上扬1.00%，台湾加权指数上升0.22%，新加坡海峡时报指数起0.40%，泰国曼谷综指升0.37%。 不过，菲律宾马尼拉综指和韩国首尔综指各跌1.15%和0.89%。中国股市今天休市。 马币方面，联储局升息的概率增加，带动美元指数走高，马币兑美元和新元双双下滑。 根据《彭博社》行情，马币兑美元全日游走于4.0848至4.0880之间，截至下午5时报4.0852，周一收于4.0845；马币兑新元全日在3.1915至3.1968之间徘徊，截至下午5时收报3.1951，低于周一的3.1941。 棕油需求增加，带动大马衍生产品交易所12月指标期货上扬4令吉，至每公吨4582令吉。  热门新闻 百格视频

title: '马股周二情绪稍微乐观，跟随区域市场积极走势，综指小幅收涨
body: '受华尔街科技股领涨的提振，周二马股市场情绪稍微乐观，跟随区域市场积极走势，综合指数收盘小幅上涨。 截至下午闭市，综合指数涨1.60点或0.10%，至1,633.35点。 市场整体表现积极，全场上涨股667只，下跌股456只，551只平盘，另1095只股无交易。全天成交量41.76亿股，总成交额29.49亿令吉。 综指成分股涨跌互见，雀巢（NESTLE，4707，主板消费股）涨1.26令吉至91.26令吉，吉隆坡甲洞（KLK，2445，主板种植股）涨46仙至21.32令吉，国油石化（PCHEM，5183，主板工业股）涨17仙至4.30令吉，IHH医疗保健集团（IHH，5225，主板保健股）涨15仙至7.91令吉。 下跌股，国家能源（TENAGA，5347，主板公用事业股）跌10仙至12.90令吉，国油贸易（PETDAG，5681，主板能源股）跌8仙至19.12令吉。 银行股普遍走低，马银行（MAYBANK，1155）跌3仙至9.97令吉，大众银行（PBBANK，1295）跌4仙4.67令吉，联昌国际（CIMB，1023）跌3仙至7.70令吉，兴业银行（RHBBANK，1066）跌3仙至7.43令吉，丰隆银行（HLBANK，5819）持平于22.88令吉，大马银行（AMBANK，1015）跌3仙至6.47令吉。 热门股方面，今天首日上市的SLGC公司（SLG，0476，创业板建筑股）跌3仙（比IPO价低10.71%）至25仙，Zetrix AI（ZETRIX，0138，主板科技股）涨2.5仙至9仙，顶级手套（TOPGLOV，7113，主板保健股）涨9仙至87.5仙，威铖（VS，6963，主板工业股）涨1仙至33仙，速柏玛（SUPERMX，7106，主板保健股）涨2.5仙至46仙。 其他重要股项，马太平洋（MPI，3867，主板科技股）涨1.56令吉至44.96令吉，腾达科技（PENTA，7160，主板科技股）涨64仙至6.08令吉；子母牌（DLADY，3026，主板消费股）跌30仙至29.70令吉，安联保险（ALLIANZ，1163，主板金融股）跌18仙至20.62令吉。 亚太主要股指，新加坡海峡时报指数起 0.66% 至 5,701.54 点，香港恒生指数起 1.00% 至 24,280.56 点，日本日经指255数起 1.05% 至 70,683.98 点， 韩国首尔综合指数跌 0.89% 至 6,941.39 点。中国股市因国庆长假期休市。

title: 'JBPM sasar pelantikan 24,000 FSM dan FSO, perkukuh keselamatan kebakaran premis - Newswav
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR - Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia (JBPM) menyasarkan pelantikan 24,000 Pengurus Keselamatan Kebakaran (FSM) dan Pegawai Keselamatan Kebakaran (FSO) menjelang tahun 2030 sebagai langkah perkukuh kawal selia serta aspek keselamatan kebakaran di premis. Ini sekali gus menjadi kompenan penting dalam penubuhan Organisasi Keselamatan Kebakaran (OKK). Ketua Pengarah Bomba, Datuk Seri Nor Hisham Mohammad berkata, bagi pelantikan FSM, jumlahnya dijangka seramai 6,000 orang, manakala pelantikan FSO seramai 18,000 orang. Menurutnya, JBPM melihat sasaran ini sebagai satu keperluan strategik dan setakat ini seramai 498 lantikan telah dibuat membabitkan 174 peserta FSM dan 324 peserta FSO. "Ini merupakan sebahagian daripada keperluan untuk mematuhi Seksyen 27A Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988 (Pindaan 2025) yang mensyaratkan bagi mana-mana premis yang dikenakan penguatkuasaan Perakuan Bomba perlu menubuhkan OKK. "OKK itu perlu ada jumlah yang minimum untuk dilantik dan dalam kalangan itu perlu ada seorang FSM dan tiga orang FSO," katanya dalam sidang akhbar selepas Majlis Pelancaran FSM dan FSO di Menara Merdeka Maybank, di sini pada Selasa. Tambahnya, sebagai persediaan ke arah OKK, JBPM telah melaksanakan pelbagai program libat urus bersama pihak berkepentingan. Katanya, Malaysia mempunyai sekitar 9,451 premis yang ditetapkan dengan profil dan tahap risiko keselamatan kebakaran yang berbeza. "Asasnya ialah bangunan yang telah kita kategorikan di bawah Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba," ujarnya. Jelas beliau, penguatkuasaan OKK secara penuh ini dijadualkan bermula 1 April 2027 sekali gus memberikan tempoh persediaan kepada pihak industri untuk membangunkan kompetensi, struktur organisasi dan tahap pematuhan yang diperlukan. "FSM dan FSO tidak akan mengambil alih peranan JBPM, tetapi melengkapkan ekosistem keselamatan kebakaran melalui pengurusan risiko secara berterusan di peringkat premis," ujarnya. Nor Hisham berkata, salah satu fungsi FSM ialah mengurangkan beban kepada penguatkuasaan berkaitan Perakuan Bomba. "Kalau pada amalan semasa ini berdasarkan prosedur-prosedur semasa kita periksa setiap tahun untuk kita keluarkan Sijil Perakuan Bomba. Tetapi di masa hadapan, tempoh itu akan kita jarakkan lagi. "Laporan pemeriksaan akan disediakan oleh FSM sebelum kita menilai dan membuat pembaharuan," ujarnya. Nor Hisham sebelum itu menyerahkan sijil perakuan kepada kumpulan pertama FSM serta FSO yang memenuhi syarat kelayakan ditetapkan.
