title: 'Maybank sumbang empat Smart TV kepada SMK Santubong
body: 'SANTUBONG: Maybank Wilayah Sarawak menyumbangkan empat unit televisyen pintar (Smart TV) kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan (SMK) Santubong bagi menyokong transformasi pendidikan digital di sekolah berkenaan.  Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat, Dato Sri Nancy Shukri berkata, kemudahan itu dijangka menjadikan suasana pembelajaran lebih interaktif, menarik dan selaras dengan perkembangan teknologi pendidikan masa kini.  “Dengan adanya Smart TV ini, suasana pembelajaran akan lebih interaktif, menarik dan selaras dengan perkembangan teknologi pendidikan masa kini.  “Kita tidak mahu anak-anak belajar di kampung ketinggalan. Jadi ini adalah kelebihan kerjasama dengan pelbagai pihak,” katanya ketika berucap pada Program Maybank Global CR Day 2026 dan Program Cabaran Cahaya Kasih 2026–2027 di SMK Santubong, di sini, hari ini.  Menurut Nancy yang juga Ahli Parlimen P193 Santubong, kerjasama antara Maybank dan Parlimen Santubong bukan perkara baharu apabila bantuan turut disalurkan kepada Pusat Aktiviti Kanak-Kanak (PAKK) Bandar Baru Semariang pada 2024 dan 2025 bagi menambah baik kemudahan serta keselesaan pembelajaran.  Katanya, setiap penerima manfaat akan dibimbing dan diberikan sokongan secara berterusan bagi memastikan manfaat yang diberikan lebih menyeluruh dan berkekalan.  “Jadi, ini adalah kesinambungan kerjasama dengan pihak Maybank. SMK Santubong dan PAKK Bandar Baru Semariang adalah antara yang terbaik di Sarawak ini,” katanya.  Dalam pada itu, Nancy berkata pendidikan sentiasa menjadi keutamaan sebagai Ahli Parlimen Santubong kerana mahu melihat anak-anak mendapat peluang dan akses pendidikan yang lebih baik.  Katanya, pendidikan membuka peluang kepada pekerjaan, meningkatkan pendapatan dan membantu sesebuah keluarga membina kehidupan yang lebih baik.  “Gunakanlah kesemua kemudahan dan peluang yang dicipta ini dengan sebaik mungkin. Jadikanlah pendidikan sebagai jalan untuk mengubah kehidupan diri dan keluarga.  “Janganlah dijadikan tempat tinggal atau latar belakang keluarga sebagai penghalang. Saya yakin ilmu dan usaha yang berterusan mampu membantu anak-anak mencapai cita-cita yang diimpikan,” katanya.  Nancy turut menggesa ibu bapa supaya memberikan sokongan kepada anak-anak untuk meneruskan persekolahan, termasuk pelajar dari kawasan pesisir yang membantu keluarga dalam pekerjaan seperti perikanan.  “Kalau kita belajar lebih baik, mempunyai cita-cita yang tinggi, maka insya-Allah nak jadi nelayan pun boleh, tetapi nelayan yang moden dan berjaya,” katanya.  Beliau turut berkongsi pengalaman berjalan kaki sejauh tiga hingga empat kilometer ke sekolah rendah ketika zaman persekolahan sebagai antara pendorong untuk terus belajar sehingga ke universiti.  Dalam pada itu, beliau merakamkan penghargaan kepada Maybank Wilayah Sarawak serta semua pihak yang menyumbang bakti, kewangan dan kepakaran dalam menjayakan program berkenaan.  Nancy turut mengucapkan Selamat Menyambut Hari Malaysia kepada semua yang hadir.

title: 'Maybank, Asian Banking School Explore Certification Programme For Wealth Advisory
body: 'Maybank and the Asian Banking School (ABS) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore the development of a professional certification framework for wealth advisory in Malaysia, aimed at introducing an industry-recognised benchmark for advisory capability.  The proposed certification framework, to be known as the ABS Wealth Advisory & Management Certification Programme, is intended to establish competency standards specifically for wealth advisory professionals in banking. Upon its launch, it will be Malaysia’s first industry-wide professional certification framework dedicated to wealth advisory.  The parties noted that as wealth management needs grow more complex, clients increasingly require advice that connects different aspects of their financial lives. This initiative they added aims to establish a consistent benchmark for the advisory capabilities required to serve clients holistically.  Maybank will serve as the Founding Industry Partner, contributing insights and its experience in developing wealth talent, while ABS will bring its expertise in professional banking development and certification. ABS will retain independence over the standards and how they are assessed and certified.  “This collaboration with the Asian Banking School allows us to contribute that experience beyond our organisation, to raise professional standards for wealth advisory in Malaysia, with the opportunity to extend elements of the programme across the region over time,” said Syed Ahmad Taufik Albar, Group CEO, Community Financial Services, Maybank.  The programme’s first intake is expected in the second half of 2027, and Maybank intends to incorporate the programme into Maybank Wealth Academy, connecting it with structured learning and career development through practical workplace application. The parties will also explore opportunities to extend relevant certification pathways to wealth professionals across the region.

title: 'Maybank lengkap ambil alih baki 30.95 peratus ekuiti Maybank Ageas
body: 'PETALING JAYA: Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) melengkapkan cadangan pengambilalihan baki kepentingan 30.95 peratus dalam Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad selepas menandatangani perjanjian pembelian saham (SPA) bersama Ageas Insurance International NV (Ageas). Pengambilalihan itu disempurnakan menyusuli kelulusan kawal selia yang diterima daripada Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) bagi membolehkan MAHB kini beroperasi sebagai anak syarikat milik penuh Maybank. Maybank Ageas merupakan syarikat pegangan bagi perniagaan Etiqa di Malaysia dan Singapura yang menyediakan rangkaian lengkap produk insurans hayat dan am konvensional serta takaful keluarga dan am. Presiden dan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Maybank, Datuk Seri Khairussaleh Ramli berkata, pencapaian itu merupakan mercu tanda penting bagi Maybank dalam usaha memperkukuh aspirasi Etiqa untuk menjadi peneraju insurans dan takaful nasional serta organisasi bertaraf global di bawah strategi ROAR30. “Dengan Maybank Ageas kini menjadi anak syarikat milik penuh, kedudukan Etiqa sebagai peneraju insurans dan takaful nasional semakin kukuh, sekali gus memperluas capaian kepada pangkalan pelanggan Maybank. “Fokus kami adalah untuk memacu nilai kepada pelanggan di seluruh Asia Tenggara melalui tawaran kekayaan serantau, strategi jualan silang serta penyediaan penyelesaian kewangan yang lebih bersepadu,” katanya dalam kenyataan. Menurut beliau, pemilikan penuh itu turut mengukuhkan penciptaan nilai jangka panjang yang mampan menerusi pengurusan modal yang lebih berkesan dan cekap di peringkat Kumpulan Maybank. “Jenama Etiqa kekal sebagai francais insurans dan takaful yang kukuh dan akan terus diletakkan sebagai salah satu jenama utama Maybank. “Kami juga ingin merakamkan penghargaan kepada Ageas atas kerjasama selama 25 tahun bersama Maybank serta sumbangan mereka dalam membangunkan francais Etiqa,” tambahnya. Maybank Ageas berada pada kedudukan kukuh untuk memanfaatkan peluang pertumbuhan dalam sektor insurans dan takaful menerusi pangkalan pelanggan yang besar serta rangkaian pengedaran menyeluruh Kumpulan. Langkah berkenaan turut membolehkan Maybank dan Maybank Ageas meningkatkan keupayaan bagi memacu inovasi produk, memperluas penembusan insurans perbankan dan memperkukuh tawaran takaful di samping meningkatkan kecekapan operasi. – UTUSAN

title: 'Sunway Construction could bag RM1b mixed-use development contracts near Bukit Chagar — Maybank IB
body: 'Sunway Construction could bag RM1b mixed-use development contracts near Bukit Chagar — Maybank IB KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 10): Sunway Construction Group Bhd (KL:SUNCON) could win an estimated RM1 billion in podium and tower contracts for an integrated mixed-use development at the Bukit Chagar RTS Link, Johor Bahru, according to Maybank Investment Bank. The research house noted that the potential win came from a joint venture development between its parent company, Sunway Bhd (KL:SUNWAY), and Mass Rapid Transit Corporation (MRT Corp), which could increase Sunway Construction’s overall net profit by about RM60 million. Consequently, Maybank IB mantained its “buy” call and RM9.62 target price, pegged to 17.7 times the financial year ending Dec 31, 2027 (FY2027) estimated price earnings. Previously, Sunway Construction had secured a RM1.5 billion contract to undertake construction works for the rapid transit system (RTS) transit-oriented development at Bukit Chagar, Johor, in a related-party transaction last year. At the time of writing, Sunway Construction shares were down three sen or 0.38% at RM7.95, valuing the company at RM10.6 billion. RM11 billion worth of development value surrounding Bukit Chagar station Analysts estimate that the total development value surrounding the Bukit Chagar station will reach a combined RM11 billion across the three largest surrounding projects. The commercial opening of the RTS Link in late 2026 or early 2027 is widely anticipated to catalyse property demand and accelerate construction timelines in the zone. The three anchor projects driving the node represent a combined gross development value of RM11.1 billion, consisting of the RM5 billion Coronation Square, the RM3.5 billion Causewayz Square, and the RM2.6 billion Sunway-MRT Corp integrated development. Of the trio, Coronation Square — an eight-tower integrated hub comprising offices, residential units, medical facilities, and an Ascott hotel — is slated for completion by 2029. Meanwhile, the wider Sunway-MRT Corp integrated development will be phased over eight years, with its primary components targeted for completion between 2033 and 2036. Binastra emerges as major Causewayz Square’s beneficiary Causewayz Square, a high-density mixed residential and retail project developed by EXSIM Group, is targeted for full completion by December 2030. Maybank IB highlighted the project's significance for Binastra Corporation Bhd (KL:BNASTRA), noting that the RM1.3 billion worth of contracts secured from this development accounts for approximately 20% of the builder's outstanding order book. Within this package, the main RM1.2 billion construction job is projected to contribute roughly RM90 million to the group's net profit. At the time of writing, Binastra Corporation shares were down one sen or 0.4% at RM2.47, valuing the company at RM2.7 billion. The proposed 50km elevated transit network will comprise 32 stations across the Skudai, Tebrau and Iskandar Puteri corridors, converging at the Bukit Chagar station. It will serve as the RTS Link’s feeder and last-mile connection, dispersing up to 10,000 cross-border passengers per hour into the Johor Bahru area. The content is a snapshot from Publisher. title: 'Maybank to acquire rest of Maybank Ageas for RM4.83 billion
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) has entered into an unconditional share purchase agreement (SPA) with Belgium-based Ageas Insurance International NV to acquire the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Bhd (MAHB) for RM4.83 billion. In a filing with Bursa Malaysia today, Maybank said the agreement involves acquiring 78 million MAHB shares from Ageas. The banking group said it signed the SPA today after receiving approval from Bank Negara Malaysia on Sept 1 and that the purchase consideration will be funded entirely through internally generated funds. Maybank said the proposed acquisition is intended to enable it to wholly own MAHB and provide the group with greater strategic flexibility. “The acquisition is also aimed at strengthening MAHB’s position as a national insurance and takaful player, supporting expansion across Southeast Asia, enhancing sustainable and resilient long-term value for the Maybank group, and improving capital management efficiency across its insurance and takaful franchises. “Full ownership of MAHB is expected to provide both Maybank and MAHB with greater strategic agility to accelerate product innovation, deepen bancassurance penetration, expand takaful propositions, and enhance capital and operational efficiency across the insurance and takaful franchises,” it said. Barring unforeseen circumstances, Maybank said that the proposed acquisition is expected to be completed on Sept 11. Maybank Investment Bank Bhd has been appointed as the principal adviser, while Morgan Stanley Asia (Singapore) Pte has been appointed as its international financial adviser.

title: 'Maybank lancar Savings+ di MAE
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Maybank memperkenalkan Savings+, ciri pelaburan pasaran wang baharu menerusi aplikasi MAE yang membolehkan pelanggan melabur serendah RM10 dalam dana pasaran wang patuh Syariah. Penyelesaian itu menawarkan alternatif kepada pelanggan untuk menjana potensi pulangan daripada lebihan tunai tanpa perlu menggunakan platform atau aplikasi pelaburan berasingan. Melalui Maybank Savings+, pelanggan boleh melabur dalam dana pasaran wang patuh Syariah yang diuruskan oleh Maybank Asset Management Sdn Bhd. Dana berkenaan menyasarkan untuk mengekalkan kecairan melalui pelaburan dalam aset cair dan berjangka pendek selain menawarkan potensi pulangan sehingga 3.32 peratus setahun. Potensi pulangan itu adalah berdasarkan rekod setakat 30 Jun 2026, namun tidak dijamin dan boleh berubah mengikut keadaan pasaran serta prestasi dana. Pulangan pelaburan dikira setiap hari dan dikreditkan kepada pelanggan secara bulanan manakala pelaburan boleh dimulakan dengan nilai minimum RM10. Ketua Perkhidmatan Kewangan Komuniti Malaysia Maybank, Mohd Amri Mohd Sofian, berkata pelancaran Savings+ mencerminkan usaha kumpulan itu menjadikan pelaburan semudah urusan perbankan harian. "Melalui Savings+, pelanggan boleh memulakan pelaburan mereka serendah RM10 sambil menguruskan wang mereka menerusi aplikasi MAE yang sememangnya digunakan setiap hari," katanya dalam kenyataan. Beliau berkata, Savings+ direka untuk memenuhi keperluan pelanggan yang menguruskan urusan kewangan secara digital menerusi aplikasi MAE. "Melalui aplikasi itu, pelanggan boleh melengkapkan proses pendaftaran, membuat pelaburan, memantau prestasi pelaburan serta menetapkan pelaburan automatik secara bulanan. "Tiada tempoh penguncian dikenakan bagi pelaburan berkenaan manakala urus niaga pelaburan dan pengeluaran dijangka diproses dalam tempoh purata dua hari bekerja," katanya. Bagi memulakan pelaburan, pelanggan hanya perlu membuka aplikasi MAE dan memilih ikon Savings+ di bawah menu 'View All' Pelanggan kemudian perlu mengikuti arahan pada skrin untuk melengkapkan proses pendaftaran termasuk Penilaian Kesesuaian sebelum membuat pelaburan awal serendah RM10. "Savings+ turut memperluaskan rangkaian penyelesaian pelaburan digital yang ditawarkan menerusi aplikasi MAE. title: 'Maybank, Ageas meterai perjanjian ambil alih MAHB bernilai RM4.38 bilion
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR - Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) memeterai perjanjian jual beli saham (SPA) tanpa syarat dengan Ageas Insurance International NV yang berpangkalan di Belgium untuk mengambil alih baki 30.95 peratus kepentingan ekuiti dalam Maybank Ageas Holdings Bhd (MAHB) dengan nilai RM4.83 bilion.  Dalam makluman kepada Bursa Malaysia hari ini, Maybank berkata perjanjian itu melibatkan pengambilalihan 78 juta saham MAHB daripada Ageas.  Kumpulan perbankan itu berkata SPA berkenaan ditandatangani hari ini selepas menerima kelulusan daripada Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) pada 1 Sept 2026, manakala balasan pembelian akan dibiayai sepenuhnya melalui dana yang dijana secara dalaman.  Maybank berkata cadangan pengambilalihan itu bertujuan membolehkannya memiliki MAHB sepenuhnya serta memberikan kumpulan itu fleksibiliti strategik yang lebih besar.  “Pengambilalihan itu juga bertujuan mengukuhkan kedudukan MAHB sebagai pemain insurans dan takaful nasional, menyokong pengembangan di seluruh Asia Tenggara, meningkatkan nilai jangka panjang yang mampan dan berdaya tahan bagi kumpulan Maybank, serta meningkatkan kecekapan pengurusan modal merentasi francais insurans dan takafulnya.  “Pemilikan penuh MAHB dijangka memberikan Maybank dan MAHB ketangkasan strategik yang lebih besar untuk mempercepat inovasi produk, memperluas penembusan bancassurance, mengembangkan penawaran takaful serta meningkatkan kecekapan modal dan operasi merentasi francais insurans dan takaful,” katanya.  Maybank berkata, sekiranya tiada keadaan tidak diduga, cadangan pengambilalihan itu dijangka selesai pada 11 Sept 2026.  Maybank Investment Bank Bhd dilantik sebagai penasihat utama, manakala Morgan Stanley Asia (Singapore) Pte dilantik sebagai penasihat kewangan antarabangsanya.  — BERNAMA

title: 'Maybank emerges as top winner at inaugural Bursa Malaysia IR Awards 2026
body: 'Maybank emerges as top winner at inaugural Bursa Malaysia IR Awards 2026 KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 7): Malayan Banking Bhd (KL:MAYBANK) emerged as the biggest winner at the inaugural Bursa Malaysia IR Awards 2026 that was held last Friday, sweeping home three awards including Best Financial Reporting and the flagship Best Company in IR. Capping the hattrick win for the company was its sectoral win as Best Large-Cap company in IR for Financial Services while its president and group chief executive officer Datuk Seri Khairussaleh Ramli was named Best CEO in IR. The awards honoured a total of 32 winners across eight main categories, celebrating public listed companies (PLCs) and investor relations professionals who have demonstrated a strong commitment to investor engagement, market communication and corporate transparency, Bursa said in a statement on Monday. The eight categories are: - Best Company in IR (overall) tor (across 13 sectors) - Best Mid/Small-cap Company in IR by Sector (across 13 sectors) Other notable winners include Tenaga Nasional Bhd (KL:TENAGA), which took home twin awards for Best Sustainability Communications and Best Large-cap Company in IR for Utilities, and Oriental Kopi Holdings Bhd (KL:KOPI), which was named Best IPO Company in IR. The other individual award — the Best CFO in IR — went to Malkit Singh Maan of Hong Leong Bank Bhd (KL:HLBANK). Effective investor relations is important in strengthening the quality and competitiveness of Malaysia's listed companies, said Treasury secretary general Tan Sri Johan Mahmood Merican when delivering the keynote address at the awards celebrations. “By communicating openly and consistently with investors, public listed companies enable better-informed investment decisions and demonstrate their commitment to transparency and accountability. As we continue enhancing the competitiveness and quality of Malaysia’s listed companies, effective investor engagement will remain an enabler of long-term value creation and sustainable market growth,” Johan said. The inaugural awards aimed to recognise companies and professionals who are setting a high standard for transparency, engagement and market communication, said Bursa CEO Datuk Fad'l Mohamed. "By spotlighting these practices, we hope to encourage more listed companies to strengthen their investor relations capabilities and help raise standards of investor engagement across the market," he said. He also noted that there is considerable opportunity to strengthen IR capabilities across the market and enhance issuer-investor engagement across the market. Based on Bursa's research, only 32% of listed companies have a dedicated internal IR function while 17% outsource the function and 51% operate without any formal IR structure. The exchange operator and regulator said it has been building IR capabilities in the capital market through IR4U by providing practical guidance and learning opportunities for PLCs, which saw the participation of about 690 listed companies throughout 2024 and 2025. These efforts are complemented by MY Value Up, the national capital market initiative jointly launched by the Securities Commission Malaysia and Bursa to encourage companies to strengthen fundamentals while articulating their strategies and priorities more clearly to the market. The complete list of award winners will be featured in a special pullout in The Edge Malaysia weekly. The content is a snapshot from Publisher. Refer to the original content for accurate info. title: 'Maybank raises Malaysia and ASEAN-6 growth forecasts as Invest ASEAN 2026 opens in Singapore
body: 'Around 200 institutional investors are gathering in Singapore for Maybank's flagship Invest ASEAN conference, as the bank lifts its 2026 GDP growth outlook for Malaysia and the wider ASEAN-6 region. Around 200 institutional investors and prime brokerage clients with a combined $23 trillion (MYR93 trillion) in global assets under management are convening at Maybank Investment Banking Group's ("Maybank IBG") flagship event, Invest ASEAN, on 7-8 July in Singapore. The event connects investors with 54 companies including a sovereign wealth fund, alongside meetings with key government bodies in Singapore. The companies are from ASEAN-6 markets (Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines and Vietnam) and India, representing total market capitalisation of $553 billion. Spanning banking, technology, consumer, healthcare, manufacturing and renewable energy sectors, the companies were selected based on clients' preferred names, a mix of mid and large caps, readiness to engage with global investors and Maybank IBG's research views. Michael Oh-Lau, chief executive officer, Maybank Investment Banking Group said, "Now in its 13th edition, Invest ASEAN reinforces Maybank's long-standing commitment to connecting investors with companies while providing the insights and conviction needed to navigate today's evolving global landscape. This year's attendance surpassed our expectations, highlighting sustained interest from both global and local investors in ASEAN as the region continues to demonstrate resilience amid global uncertainties. Energy transition, supply chain reconfiguration and AI-led digital transformation are key themes at this year's Invest ASEAN, and we expect these trends to continue over the next few years." Reflecting improved conditions, Maybank's research has revised its ASEAN-6 GDP growth forecast upwards to +4.7% from its estimate of +4.5% in March (2027E: +4.7%). Oil prices have fallen from their peak to near pre-war levels and tanker traffic via the Strait of Hormuz is recovering. In Malaysia, Maybank has revised its full-year 2026 GDP growth forecast upwards to 4.9% from 4.4%, reflecting resilient economic momentum in the first half of the year despite the heightened geopolitical risks. Economic indicators for April and May point to another quarter of growth above 5%, underpinned by robust manufacturing activities and stronger net exports as Malaysia benefits from the AI-driven technology upcycle, and being a net energy exporter amid higher commodity prices. Outlook for the second half of 2026 remains healthy, especially amid the sustained momentum in investment approvals, particularly in technology, renewable energy, industrial real estate and infrastructure segments. Maybank also remains positive on the market, with a year-end FBM KLCI target of 1,750 based on 7.5% earnings growth, sustained investment upcycle effects, stable consumer essentials spending and steady foreign participation. The expansion of KLCI to 50 constituents, from 30 currently, promises to reinvigorate broader sectoral picks whilst benefitting from the momentum of the MY Value Up initiative. As AI and data centre themes take centre stage, Maybank has upgraded its view on the technology sector, which is expected to benefit from these long-term structural growth drivers. Re-disseminated by The Asian Banker

title: 'Govt dividend receipts up 1.4% to RM39.55b in 2025 on higher BNM, Khazanah payouts — AG’s report
body: 'Govt dividend receipts up 1.4% to RM39.55b in 2025 on higher BNM, Khazanah payouts — AG’s report KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 5): The federal government received RM39.55 billion in dividends from its investments in 2025, up by 1.4% from RM39.01 billion a year earlier, as higher payouts from Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) and Khazanah Nasional Bhd outweighed lower receipts from other entities. The dividends came from 20 companies and two statutory bodies, compared with 21 companies and two statutory bodies in 2024. The increase was RM535.06 million compared to last year, according to the latest auditor general’s report released on Monday. Petroliam Nasional Bhd (PETRONAS) paid RM32 billion, unchanged from 2024. BNM paid RM5.25 billion, up from RM2.85 billion, an increase of RM2.4 billion or 84.2%. Khazanah's dividend doubled to RM2 billion from RM1 billion. Bank Simpanan Nasional paid RM25 million, down from RM52 million. Dividends from statutory bodies rose 81.8% to RM5.28 billion, while those from companies fell 5.1% to RM34.27 billion. In all, nine companies and one statutory body paid RM7.43 billion, against RM3.98 billion in 2024, an increase of RM3.45 billion or 86.7%. Twelve companies and one statutory body paid less compared to 2024, as three companies paid the same amount in both years. Piramid Pertama Sdn Bhd, which paid RM2.73 billion in 2024, made no payment in 2025. Dividends from Prokhas Sdn Bhd fell to RM5.6 million from RM56.24 million. Three companies, Perbadanan Nasional Bhd, Malaysia Debt Ventures Bhd and Malaysia Digital Economy Corp Sdn Bhd paid dividends in 2025 after paying none in 2024.
